The home side, sitting comfortably in mid-table, boasts a positive goal difference of +2 and the creativity of midfielder T. Ince, who has provided four assists, while Colchester languishes near the bottom with a -7 goal difference. This fixture carries added spice as a rivalry clash, with the U’s needing a turnaround after losing five matches, though their defensive resilience, anchored by goalkeeper T. Lo-Tutala’s 39 saves, could frustrate a Tranmere attack led by five-goal forward D. Jones. (Sports)

Bill is thrilled to meet his new housemates - Christian, Zahra, Hettie, and James - but when Christian keeps leaving the fridge door open, he has to come up with a scheme to get it shut without ruining his image as a relaxed, fun landlord. Comedy, starring Rob Brydon.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: Simply Nigella
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S1 E4 Food writer Nigella Lawson rustles up more of her favourite recipes, this time with the emphasis on cosy and comforting mood. For breakfast she makes a tray of dairy-free chai muffins and there's a low-key lunch of Asian-flavoured short ribs - a perfect make-ahead, tender beef stew. Inspired by her visits to America's west coast, an informal supper for friends features Nigella's home-made, oven-baked fish tacos, which involve a bit of DIY at the table, followed by a salted chocolate tart for pudding.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: Bargain Hunt

With 60 minutes on the clock and two medical-themed challenges to fulfil, both teams race around an antiques fair at Southwell Racecourse, Nottinghamshire. They are assisted in their endeavours by experts Stephanie Connell and Gary Pe. Natasha Raskin Sharp hosts and also speaks to Dr Jenni Hunt from the Old Operating Theatre Museum in London.

eden.uk.plus1.title: Mammals - Dark
eden.uk.plus1.description: Today, more than two-thirds of mammal species are nocturnal, and in this episode we will uncover the intriguing strategies they have evolved, from remarkable senses to teamwork, intelligence and adaptability, which have enabled them to overcome a time we find so challenging. Nocturnal mammals have developed an array of sharp senses. And, unlike us, many are blessed with incredible night vision. (Documentary, Nature) - 2024

eden.uk.plus1.title: Mammals - The New Wild
eden.uk.plus1.description: For millions of years, mammals have evolved to master every environment on Earth, but the planet is changing rapidly, all thanks to one mammal in particular - humans. As mankind reshapes the face of the world, mammals must change with it if they are to survive, let alone thrive. Today, some are finding clever and surprising ways to make the most of this new wild, while others need a helping hand from us. (Documentary, Nature) - 2024

eden.uk.plus1.title: Mammals - Water
eden.uk.plus1.description: We witness some of the most intimate and surprising behaviours of marine mammals. Raising the bar on our understanding of how whales and dolphins make their lives at sea, as well as meeting those terrestrial mammals that dip their toes, and sometimes more, into the watery world. (Documentary, Nature) - 2024

eden.uk.plus1.title: Mammals - Cold
eden.uk.plus1.description: Having honed their survival strategies over millennia, mammals have evolved to be masters of the cold. From icy seas to snow-capped mountains, a look at the unique mammals that call these frozen worlds home. (Documentary, Nature) - 2024

stvnorth.uk.title: How to Clean Up for Cash
stvnorth.uk.description: S1 E1 Josie Gibson presents as families have a loved one's clutter cleared and valued in secret by antiques expert Dan Hatfield and declutterer Jacqueline McLeod. The first mission is in Somerset, where they help Mel, who is desperate for her husband of three years Paul to rent out his house and move in with her so his clutter has to go. However, this is no easy task as Paul is a private investigator.

stvnorth.uk.title: How to Clean Up for Cash
stvnorth.uk.description: S1 E2 Josie Gibson and the team head to north-east England to help Ashley clear out and value the clutter of her mum Mandy, who has been lured out of the house and is unaware of what is happening. From a Victorian commode to a bust of Elvis, Josie falls in love with Mandy's eclectic taste, but Ashley is determined to see it gone for good.

stvnorth.uk.title: Cooking with the Stars

They'll deliver classic British dishes on just £3 a portion all in a bid to secure a place in the semi-final. The stars who fail to impress our world-class chefs will head into the dreaded cook-off - where one more will leave the competition.

stvnorth.uk.title: James Martin's Great British Adventure
stvnorth.uk.description: S1 E2 Lossiemouth James Martin and his travelling companion Nick Nairn continue their Scottish adventure in Lossiemouth, home to the first RAF squadron and a fleet of typhoon fighter jets. James fulfils a childhood dream and Nick takes part in a fitness test.

stvnorth.uk.title: Clodagh: Cooking at Home

stvnorth.uk.title: Nations Championship : England v New Zealand

England produced an excellent display when these teams last met a year ago, claiming a 33 - 19 victory to end a run of three straight defeats at the hands of the All Blacks. With analysis from Ugo Monye, Sean Fitzpatrick and Danny Care, pitchside reports from Topsy Ojo, and commentary from Nick Mullins, David Flatman and Ben Kay.

stvnorth.uk.title: Nations Championship : Ireland v South Africa
stvnorth.uk.description: Ireland v South Africa (Kick-off 4.40pm). All the action from the match at Aviva Stadium, as both teams conclude their round-robin fixtures. These nations last faced each other 12 months ago, when the world champions claimed a 24-13 victory in a chaotic encounter that saw Ireland receive five cards, even playing with 12 men at the end of the first half, and the Springboks also get reduced to 14 men in the second half. With analysis from Bryan Habana and David Flatman, pitchside inserts by Claire Thomas and Brian O'Driscoll, and commentary from Miles Harrison and Gordon D'Arcy.

stvnorth.uk.title: EFL Live : Burnley v Blackburn Rovers
stvnorth.uk.description: S3 E4 Burnley v Blackburn Rovers (Kick-off 12.00pm). Hugh Woozencroft presents coverage of the Championship match from Turf Moor, as the rivals face each other in the East Lancashire derby. There have been 170 previous meetings between these teams in all competitions, dating back to the 1888/89 season, and it is the Clarets who narrowly hold the better record with 71 wins to Rovers 65, with the other 34 games ending in draws. The most recent meeting was in the 2024/25 campaign and saw Burnley triumph 1-0 at Ewood Park, with the corresponding clash here ending in a 1-1 stalemate. With analysis from Ben Mee and Brad Friedel, commentary by Seb Hutchinson and Lucy Ward, and reports from Katie Shanahan.

amc.us.description: Kay and Jay reunite to provide our best line of defense against a seductress who levels the toughest challenge yet to the MIB's mission statement: protecting the earth from the scum of the universe. While investigating a routine crime, Jay uncovers a plot masterminded by Serleena, a Kylothian monster who disguises herself as a lingerie model. When Serleena takes the MIB building hostage, there is only one person Jay can turn to -- his former MIB partner. (movie) - 2002

amc.us.title: The Perfect Storm
amc.us.description: Based on a true story, the film tells of the courageous men and women who risk their lives every working day, pitting their fishing boats and rescue vessels against the capricious forces of nature. Their worst fears are realized at sea on Halloween of 1991, when they are confronted by three raging weather fronts which unexpectedly collide to produce the greatest, fiercest storm in modern history -- "The Perfect Storm." (movie) - 2000

amc.us.title: Beverly Hills Cop II
amc.us.description: The hard-nosed Detroit cop returns to Los Angeles to help solve another case. This time he must direct his efforts towards unraveling the Alphabet Crimes, a series of robberies committed by leather-jacketed punks. The investigation puts him on the trail of an illegal arms dealer and his hit lady. (movie) - 1987

amc.us.title: Men in Black
amc.us.description: Working for a highly funded yet unofficial government agency, Kay and Jay are the Men in Black, providers of immigration services and regulators of all things alien on Earth. While investigating a series of unregistered close encounters, the MIB agents uncover the deadly plot of an intergalactic terrorist who is on a mission to assassinate two ambassadors from opposing galaxies currently in residence in New York City. (movie) - 1997

amc.us.title: Jurassic World Dominion
amc.us.description: Four years after the destruction of Isla Nublar, dinosaurs now live and hunt alongside humans all over the world. This fragile balance will reshape the future and determine, once and for all, whether human beings are to remain the apex predators on a planet they now share with history's most fearsome creatures. (movie) - 2022

amc.us.title: Jumanji: Welcome to the Jungle
amc.us.description: Four high school kids discover an old video game console and are drawn into the game's jungle setting, literally becoming the adult avatars they chose. What they discover is that you don't just play Jumanji - you must survive it. To beat the game and return to the real world, they'll have to go on the most dangerous adventure of their lives, discover what Alan Parrish left 20 years ago, and change the way they think about themselves - or they'll be stuck in the game forever. (movie) - 2017

amc.us.title: Red One
amc.us.description: When a villain kidnaps Santa Claus from the North Pole, an E.L.F. (Extremely Large and Formidable) operative joins forces with the world's most accomplished tracker to find him and save Christmas. (movie) - 2024

amc.us.title: Journey 2: The Mysterious Island
amc.us.description: Sean Anderson receives a coded distress signal from an island where none should exist. Knowing that he will not be able to dissuade Sean from tracking the signal to its source, Hank, Sean's new stepfather, joins the teen on a quest to the South Pacific. Together with helicopter pilot Gabato and Gabato's feisty daughter, Kailani, they set out to find the island and rescue its sole human inhabitant. (movie) - 2012

amc.us.title: The Rundown
amc.us.description: Beck (The Rock) is a tight-lipped bounty hunter who doesn't like to use a gun and accepts any job without asking questions. When Beck's employer, Walker (William Lucking), sends him to the Amazon to locate Walker's cocky son, Travis (Seann William Scott), Beck discovers a population controlled by a tyrannical treasure hunter (Christopher Walken). To survive, Beck and Travis must work together, without their affections for a mysterious rebel (Rosario Dawson) getting in the way. (movie) - 2003

amc.us.title: The Three Stooges - Uncivil Warriors

amc.us.title: Pretty in Pink
amc.us.description: Andie is an outcast at her Chicago high school, hanging out either with her older boss, who owns the record store where she works. When one of the rich and popular kids at school, Blane, asks Andie out, it seems too good to be true. As Andie starts falling for Blane, she begins to realize that dating someone from a different social sphere is not easy. (movie) - 1986

amc.us.title: The Princess Bride
amc.us.description: A fairy tale adventure about a beautiful young woman and her one true love. He must find her after a long separation and save her. They must battle the evils of the mythical kingdom of Florin to be reunited with each other. Based on the William Goldman novel "The Princess Bride" which earned its own loyal audience. babytv.uk.title: The Tiny Bunch
babytv.uk.description: Baby and Hippo have planned a day at the beach together. But once they get there, Hippo disappears. Come join Baby as he looks for Hippo. S1 Ep2

babytv.uk.title: The Tiny Bunch
babytv.uk.description: Baby helps Turtle look for the loud sound that was keeping him up at night. Was it Giraffe playing the drums? Squirrel eating acorns? Come find out! S1 Ep9

babytv.uk.description: Billy and Bam make their own xylophone from colorful glasses. Come hear the music they make.

babytv.uk.title: Billy Bam Bam
babytv.uk.description: Billy and Bambam throw a birthday party for Dolly's birthday. They have everything you need - balloons, party hats, party blowers and cake of course!

babytv.uk.title: Billy Bam Bam
babytv.uk.description: Billy and Bam find a hungry mouse while enjoying thier picnic. They give it some bread and cheese and then they all play hide and seek!

babytv.uk.title: Mona & Sketch
babytv.uk.description: Join Sketch as he scribbles a thermometer and band aids! Help fix butterfly's torn wing and see him fly again! S1 Ep1

babytv.uk.title: Mona & Sketch
babytv.uk.description: Join Sketch as he scribbles stars and a spaceship! Help use a fan to sprinkle stardust on a star to make it twinkle! S1 Ep11

babytv.uk.title: Mona & Sketch
babytv.uk.description: Join Sketch as he scribbles a diving mask and a boat! Help save Sketch from a pink octopus under the sea!

babytv.uk.title: Snail Trail
babytv.uk.description: Mr. Snail meets a smart street cat! Find out where cat plays and sleeps! See his paws and claws!

babytv.uk.title: Snail Trail
babytv.uk.description: Two dung beetles are fighting over a dung ball! Discover that they roll it and prepare food out of it!

babytv.uk.title: Snail Trail
babytv.uk.description: Join Mr. Snail as he meets a lovely cricket at night! Discover how he makes that sound by rubbing his wings!

babytv.uk.title: Ahoy Pirates!
babytv.uk.description: The three brave pirates are on their way to new and exciting adventures at sea!

babytv.uk.title: Ahoy Pirates!

babytv.uk.title: Snail Trail
babytv.uk.description: Mr. Snail meets a song bird! See what happens when poisonous rattle snakes arrive! Everyone is in a different rhythm!

babytv.uk.title: Snail Trail
babytv.uk.description: Mr. Snail meets Mrs. Salmon by the river! Salmon jumped too far and landed outside the water!

babytv.uk.title: Ahoy Lollipops
babytv.uk.description: The Lollipops find themselves in a tight spot after accidently running into a trap. Luckily a llama is there to lend a hand.

babytv.uk.title: LaLe Ki LoLu
babytv.uk.description: Lale and Lolu visit the magical world of ancient Egypt in the winter with it's hieroglyphics, pyramids and colossal statues.

babytv.uk.title: LaLe Ki LoLu
babytv.uk.description: Lale and Lolu visit a magical castle in the winter time! They play hide and seek with a friendly dragon.

babytv.uk.title: Songs & Rhymes
babytv.uk.description: Elephant and Baby Butterfly go on an expedition under the sea in a yellow submarine.

babytv.uk.title: Travelers
babytv.uk.description: Have you ever tried cleaning a carpet while it's moving? Join in on the fun as Harley and Perry try to clean a mischievous carpet on cleaning day.

babytv.uk.title: Pix & Leo
babytv.uk.description: Leo and Pix are looking for the perfect place to have a picnic. While Leo takes a nap, Pix finds a new friend to play with.

babytv.uk.title: Mowgli Welcome to the Jungle
babytv.uk.description: Ikki finds herself in a bind when she gets her quills stuck in tree. When Mowgli comes along and offers to help, she thinks he wants to eat her!

babytv.uk.title: Welcome to the island
babytv.uk.description: It's Coco's birthday and the gang have planned a surprise party for him! They even invited the Coral Reef singers!

babytv.uk.title: Welcome to the island
babytv.uk.description: Lily is super excited - it's the first time she is going to give pollen to a bee! Turns out she's a bit too excited and she can't stop sneezing.

babytv.uk.title: Songs & Rhymes
babytv.uk.description: Baby Hippo is learning how to walk. On his way he meets a flying butterfly, a jumping frog and a crawling snail.

babytv.uk.title: Mini Matinee
babytv.uk.description: Join the loveable animal friends as they visit Mexico. Jose makes himself a big hat! When it's hot and when it rains, it protects him!

babytv.uk.title: Mini Matinee
babytv.uk.description: Join the loveable animal friends as they visit China. Chop, the driver, serves the King and Queen a meal, but where's the cutlery?

babytv.uk.title: Mini Matinee
babytv.uk.description: Join the loveable animal friends as they visit Scotland. Kenny plays his pipe but one day it is lost! His family brings him many pipes.

babytv.uk.title: Mona & Sketch
babytv.uk.description: Join Sketch as he scribbles an engine and train cars! Help create parachutes when the train runs out of tracks!

babytv.uk.title: Mona & Sketch
babytv.uk.description: Join the fun as Sketch scribbles a magician's hat and wand! Help conduct a magic show with flying doves and feathers!

babytv.uk.title: Mice Builders
babytv.uk.description: Join the mighty mice builders as they work and play! Come sing along and help them build their new home! What's inside the package? A rubbish bin for throwing out rubbish!

babytv.uk.title: Billy BamBam
babytv.uk.description: Join them as they have fun playing an imaginative game with paper towels and inventing their own song about a choo-choo train!

babytv.uk.title: Billy BamBam
babytv.uk.description: Join them as they have fun using pan lids as cymbals, singing, and dancing in their band.

babytv.uk.title: Bug'n'Play to the Rescue
babytv.uk.description: Bug'n'Play to the Rescue,Songs & Rhymes,Zeina's Detective Agency ,Billy Bam Bam,Songs & Rhymes,Look What I Found, Songs & Rhymes, Dino & the Egg Hunt.

babytv.uk.title: Olly
babytv.uk.description: Dolly has gotten a magical package from her grandma. What can it be? Everyone is very curious. Come found out.

babytv.uk.title: Stitches
babytv.uk.description: Needles wants to go sledding with his friends. Turns out it's not an easy task when everyone wants to go first.

babytv.uk.title: The Lollipops
babytv.uk.description: Sharing is caring but that's not always easy! The girls fight over a doll they all want to play with but luckily their friendship prevails! S1 Ep4

babytv.uk.title: The Lollipops
babytv.uk.description: The Lollipops enjoy a picnic at the park when the wind starts to pick up. The girls are busy chasing Jon Jon's hat, Beth's scarf and keeping warm.

babytv.uk.title: Giggle Wiggle
babytv.uk.description: Joe the monkey loves to monkey around. Come join him in the jungle and follow in his steps - clap your hands, stomp your feet and scratch your head.

babytv.uk.title: Giggle Wiggle
babytv.uk.description: Join the dog on the farm who likes to run, jump and bark. Want to bark loud enough for the birds to to hear?

babytv.uk.title: Giggle Wiggle
babytv.uk.description: Ready to dance and sing with Nick the chick? Flap your wings, walk and kick! Don't forget to open your beak!

babytv.uk.title: Songs & Rhymes
babytv.uk.description: Five little monkeys jumping on the bed! Can you guess what happens? One falls off and bumps his head! Somebody call the doctor!

babytv.uk.description: Join Charlie as he helps Number Ten look for his missing walking stick and then join them as they set out to have fun singing and dancing.

babytv.uk.title: Charlie & the Shapes
babytv.uk.description: Yellow rectangle doesn't want to be late for the shapes' party. But grey rectangle is taking his time drinking tea.

babytv.uk.title: Charlie & the Shapes
babytv.uk.description: Green square and spiral try to prove who's the strongest. Who do you think will win?

babytv.uk.description: Teeny and Tiny play what is hiding beneath the handkerchief, What's the odd one out and the big an small game.

babytv.uk.title: The Tiny Bunch
babytv.uk.description: Baby and Giraffe want to build a snowman together, but by the time Giraffe is ready to go out - all the snow has melted? S1 Ep4

babytv.uk.title: The Tiny Bunch
babytv.uk.description: Squirrel has invited Baby to sleep over. What happens when Squirrel wants to go to sleep but Baby still wants to have fun? S1 Ep26

babytv.uk.title: The Tiny Bunch
babytv.uk.description: Baby has picked beautiful flowers for sheep but is having trouble flying while holding the flowers. Luckily, he has her good friends. S1 Ep6

babytv.uk.title: Billy BamBam
babytv.uk.description: Billy and Bambam learn how to mix colors in order to make new ones. When they finish painting, they use the colorful bottles as bowling pins.

babytv.uk.title: Billy BamBam
babytv.uk.description: Join them as they have fun playing an imaginative game with paper towels and inventing their own song about a choo-choo train!

babytv.uk.title: Billy BamBam
babytv.uk.description: Join them as they have fun using pan lids as cymbals, singing, and dancing in their band.

babytv.uk.title: Mona & Sketch
babytv.uk.description: Join Sketch as he scribbles an engine and train cars! Help create parachutes when the train runs out of tracks!

babytv.uk.title: Mona & Sketch
babytv.uk.description: Join the fun as Sketch scribbles a magician's hat and wand! Help conduct a magic show with flying doves and feathers!

babytv.uk.title: Mona & Sketch
babytv.uk.description: Join Sketch as he scribbles a helmet, a cement mixer and a crane! Come along and help drill at the building site! S1 Ep4

babytv.uk.title: Snail Trail
babytv.uk.description: Join Mr. Snail as he meets a lovely cricket at night! Discover how he makes that sound by rubbing his wings!

babytv.uk.title: Snail Trail
babytv.uk.description: Mr. Snail meets a frog in the pond! Splash along and help Mr. Snail solve frog's riddles! Who lives in the water and on land and blows balloons?

babytv.uk.title: Ahoy Pirates!
babytv.uk.description: The three brave pirates are on their way to new and exciting adventures at sea!

babytv.uk.title: Ahoy Pirates!
babytv.uk.description: The three brave pirates are on their way to new and exciting adventures at sea!

babytv.uk.title: Snail Trail
babytv.uk.description: Mr. Snail discovers a nest on a porch! Join him as he sees a little chick hatch from its egg!

babytv.uk.title: Snail Trail
babytv.uk.description: Mr. Snail explores grass in a garden! Join him as he meets a grasshopper! Discover how his green colour helps him hide from lizards!

babytv.uk.title: Ahoy Lollipops
babytv.uk.description: Crossing a bridge can be quite a challenge when half of it is missing! How will the girls cross? With bubbles of course!

babytv.uk.title: LaLe Ki LoLu
babytv.uk.description: Lale and Lolu have fun in their imaginary and colorful circus world.

babytv.uk.title: LaLe Ki LoLu
babytv.uk.description: Lale and Lolu have fun in their imaginary circus world in the wintertime.

babytv.uk.title: Travelers
babytv.uk.description: On your marks, get set, go! Harley and Perry are off on a race in their rubber duck boats. Harley is out to win and isn't playing fair.

babytv.uk.title: Pix & Leo
babytv.uk.description: Pix and Leo go to a lot of trouble trying to get a bunch of grapes hanging from a tall tree. Mama bird also has her eyes on the grapes.

babytv.uk.title: Mowgli Welcome to the Jungle
babytv.uk.description: Mowgli has a tough time falling asleep with all the noises he hears in the jungle. He decides to sing to himself which helps him calm down.

babytv.uk.title: Welcome to the island
babytv.uk.description: It's an exciting day on the island when a turtle and her numerous kids arrive on the island and make quite the racket.

babytv.uk.title: Welcome to the island
babytv.uk.description: The four friends on the island are unpleasantly surprised when two octopuses begin littering the island. S1 Ep5

babytv.uk.title: Songs & Rhymes
babytv.uk.description: Toto, Robbie and Dolly are all busy baking a cake! After pouring all the ingredients in the pan Robbie uses his hand as a whip to whip them all up.

babytv.uk.title: Songs & Rhymes
babytv.uk.description: Baby Butterfly tucks everyone in bed sending them off to a peaceful sleep - Elephant, Draco, Oliver, Charlie and Lola. Good night everyone.

babytv.uk.title: Mini Matinee
babytv.uk.description: Join the loveable animal friends as they visit Hawaii. Robert the florist is sad because nobody is buying flowers.

babytv.uk.title: Mini Matinee
babytv.uk.description: Join the loveable animal friends as they visit Lebanon. Bashir loves his cherry tree! Follow the pit trail to find out who ate Bashir's cherries!

babytv.uk.title: Mini Matinee
babytv.uk.description: Join the loveable animal friends as they visit Jordan. Khaled offers to paint his sisters' tent. Saeed mixes red and pink petals to create a powder!

babytv.uk.title: Mona & Sketch
babytv.uk.description: Join the fun as Sketch scribbles a shovel and a sieve! Help Mona dig in the ground and discover an ancient treasure! S1 Ep3

babytv.uk.title: Mona & Sketch
babytv.uk.description: Join the fun as Sketch scribbles wooden planks and tools! Step into the workshop and build a table and chair! S1 Ep8

babytv.uk.title: Mice Builders
babytv.uk.description: Join the mighty mice builders as they work and play! Come sing along and help them build their new home! What's inside the package? A chair to sit on while eating a tasty meal!

babytv.uk.title: Billy BamBam
babytv.uk.description: Billy and Bam Bam have fun playing with the little doll house and doll family they received as a present. S1 Ep2

babytv.uk.title: Billy BamBam
babytv.uk.description: When the kites get stuck, they are left with the strings and find imaginative ways to play with them and wag their new "tails"!

babytv.uk.title: Songs & Rhymes
babytv.uk.description: All your favorite BabyTV characters are rolling over in the bed. Be careful not to fall out!

babytv.uk.title: Bug'n'Play to the Rescue
babytv.uk.description: Butterson finds hinself in a sticky situation after retrieving a ball from a high branch. Will he be able to get down safely? Come find out!

babytv.uk.title: Olly
babytv.uk.description: Olly the magician is putting on a magic show! Come see him pull a rabbit out of hat, turn a flower into bubbles and make Kitty disappear!

babytv.uk.title: Stitches
babytv.uk.description: Needles and Flippy dive deep into the ocean for a fun adventure underwater. After a game of tag Needles gets stuck in the seaweed.

babytv.uk.title: The Lollipops
babytv.uk.description: Get off the couch and come join in the fun! The Lollipops are sure to get you off your feet with their easy dance moves.

babytv.uk.title: Giggle Wiggle
babytv.uk.description: Joe the monkey loves to monkey around. Come join him in the jungle and follow in his steps - clap your hands, stomp your feet and scratch your head.

babytv.uk.title: Giggle Wiggle
babytv.uk.description: Ready to run, jump, hop turn around and touch the ground? Then get yourself a rabbit and come join me!

babytv.uk.title: Giggle Wiggle
babytv.uk.description: Let's be an elephant for a day! Wave your ears, wag your tail and lift your trunk!

babytv.uk.title: Songs & Rhymes
babytv.uk.description: Join the five little hungry mice in this fun counting rhyme as they climb on the rice pot to have a yummy feast.

babytv.uk.title: Songs & Rhymes
babytv.uk.description: What's more fun than eating cakes and breads? Eating them with your favorite BabyTV characters - Hungry Henry, Billy and Bambam, Draco and Oliver!

babytv.uk.title: Songs & Rhymes
babytv.uk.description: Billy and Bam have fun watching the bears make food together. Sometimes things don't go quite as expected but that's part of the fun.

babytv.uk.title: Charlie & the Numbers
babytv.uk.description: Join Number One, Number Three and Charlie as they successfully bring the little chick back home to reunite with his family in the nest.

babytv.uk.title: Charlie & the Numbers
babytv.uk.description: Join Charlie as he helps Number Two and Number Four resolve differences and then saves them after they got stuck on a rainbow.

babytv.uk.title: Charlie & the Shapes
babytv.uk.description: Diamond likes to look at himself in the mirror. What will he do when his mirror breaks. Come find out.

babytv.uk.title: Charlie & the Shapes
babytv.uk.description: The Queen of Hearts is looking for a star to put on her magic wand. Will Zigzag be able to help?

babytv.uk.title: Charlie & the Shapes
babytv.uk.description: Arrow leaves his friends a map with directions on how to find him. Will they find him in the end?

babytv.uk.title: Good-Morning Stretch
babytv.uk.description: Teeny and Tiny play with puppets, "who's the odd one out" game and "what is hiding beneath the handkerchief".

babytv.uk.title: Good-Morning Stretch
babytv.uk.description: Teeny and Tiny play the odd one out game, the music game, hide and seek and who's hiding beneath the handkerchief!

babytv.uk.title: Hippa Hippa Hey
babytv.uk.description: What's hiding behind the hidden picture game? A sailboat! What is the assembly machine making? Sailboats!

babytv.uk.title: Hippa Hippa Hey
babytv.uk.description: Help Hippa find the missing part to complete the sheep. Join Sophie to find out which color matches the corn. Yellow!

babytv.uk.title: Choopies
babytv.uk.description: The Choopies bring their scout leader objects they have managed to collect. Together they build something fun they all can play with!

babytv.uk.title: Choopies
babytv.uk.description: The Choopies bring their scout leader objects they have managed to collect. Together they build something fun they all can play with!

babytv.uk.title: Songs & Rhymes

babytv.uk.description: Lola learns you need to stop when the traffic light is red, meets a bird on the Ferris wheel, helps Grandpa get to the balloon shop and the park.

babytv.uk.title: Little Lola Visits the City
babytv.uk.description: Lola helps a family of elephants cross the road, helps a cat off a tall tree, finds out what's in the box Maria has brought Penguin.

babytv.uk.title: Little Lola Visits the City
babytv.uk.description: Lola learns you need to stop when the traffic light is red, meets a bird on the Ferris wheel, helps Elephant get to the balloon shop and the park.

babytv.uk.title: Little Lola Visits the Farm
babytv.uk.description: Come along and help Lola decorate bull with fresh flowers! See how horse helps foal reach the apples! Enjoy watching dandy dog flip over!

babytv.uk.title: Little Lola Visits the Farm
babytv.uk.description: Join Lola as she has fun on the farm. Play along with scarecrow and two darling doves! See how radiant ram helps lamb reach the tasty oranges!

babytv.uk.title: Ahoy Lollipops
babytv.uk.description: On their way to finding the treasure, the Lollipops need to cross a bubbly swamp. Luckily Ari the monkey is there to help.

babytv.uk.description: Mr. Snail discovers a nest on a porch! Join him as he sees a little chick hatch from its egg!

babytv.uk.title: Snail Trail
babytv.uk.description: Mr. Snail explores grass in a garden! Join him as he meets a grasshopper! Discover how his green colour helps him hide from lizards!

babytv.uk.title: Songs & Rhymes

cinemax.us.title: Walk the Line
cinemax.us.description: The rise of country music legend Johnny Cash (Joaquin Phoenix) begins with his days as a boy growing up on the family farm, where he struggles under the scorn of his father (Robert Patrick). As the years pass, Cash ends up in Memphis, Tenn., with his wife, Vivian (Ginnifer Goodwin), and breaks into the music scene after finding his trademark sound. While on tour, Cash meets the love of his life, singer June Carter (Reese Witherspoon), but Cash's volatile lifestyle threatens to keep them apart. (Biography, Historical drama, Music, Country, Rock) - 2005

cinemax.us.title: Open Water
cinemax.us.description: Daniel (Daniel Travis) and Susan (Blanchard Ryan) embark on a tropical vacation with their scuba-diving certifications in tow. During a group dive, the two separate themselves from the others to dive a little deeper. An incorrect head-count suggests the entire group has returned, so the boat departs. When the pair surfaces, they make out a vessel in the distance, but it does not immediately set in that they have been left behind. With sharks lurking beneath, their survival chances grow smaller. (Thriller, Adventure, Drama, Horror) - 2003

cinemax.us.title: Meg 2: The Trench
cinemax.us.description: Jonas Taylor leads a research team on an exploratory dive into the deepest depths of the ocean. Their voyage spirals into chaos when a malevolent mining operation threatens their mission and forces them into a high-stakes battle for survival. Pitted against colossal, prehistoric sharks and relentless environmental plunderers, they must outrun, outsmart and outswim their merciless predators. (movie) - 2023

cinemax.us.title: The Watchers

cinemax.us.title: A Good Day to Die Hard

McClane thinks his son is a criminal, so it comes as a shock when he learns that Jack is actually working undercover to protect Komarov (Sebastian Koch), a Russian government whistleblower. With their own lives on the line, McClane and Jack must overcome their differences in order to get Komarov to safety and thwart a potentially disastrous crime in the Chernobyl region. (movie) - 2013

cinemax.us.title: The Predator
cinemax.us.description: From the outer reaches of space to the small-town streets of suburbia, the hunt comes home. The universe's most lethal hunters are stronger, smarter and deadlier than ever before, having genetically upgraded themselves with DNA from other species. When a boy accidentally triggers their return to Earth, only a ragtag crew of ex-soldiers and an evolutionary biologist can prevent the end of the human race. (movie) - 2018

cinemax.us.title: Spring Breakers
cinemax.us.description: College students Candy (Vanessa Hudgens), Faith (Selena Gomez), Brit (Ashley Benson) and Cotty (Rachel Korine) are short of the cash they need for a spring-break trip, so they rob a diner and head down to Florida. However, the police soon break up the party and arrest them. The curvaceous quartet is unexpectedly bailed out by a drug dealer and aspiring rap artist named Alien (James Franco). Soon after, three of the four gal pals decide to join Alien in a life of crime. (movie) - 2012

cinemax.us.title: Catfish
cinemax.us.description: When Nev Shulman, a New York photographer, receives a Facebook request from a child named Abby, he cannot guess the unusual odyssey on which he will soon embark. Abby sends Nev an unusually skilled painting based on one of his photos. Intrigued, he begins online relationships with the rest of Abby's family, including her older sister, Megan. Though troubling inconsistencies soon emerge, Nev continues his online flirtation with Megan, resulting in a road trip to meet her in person. (movie) - 2010

cinemax.us.title: Shot Caller
cinemax.us.description: Recently released from prison, a gang member finds himself forced by his leaders to orchestrate a major crime with a rival gang. (movie) - 2017

cinemax.us.title: Hoot
cinemax.us.description: Roy Eberhardt (Logan Lerman) has moved so often he has lost track of how many times he has changed schools. After moving from Montana to Florida's Gulf Coast, he befriends Beatrice (Brie Larson) and her brother. The siblings show Roy their hideaway, where they secretly take care of a flock of wild owls. When they learn that a restaurant will be built where the owls live, the three decide to enlist the help of a local policeman (Luke Wilson) to save the birds. (movie) - 2006

cinemax.us.title: Wonka
cinemax.us.description: Armed with nothing but a hatful of dreams, young chocolatier Willy Wonka manages to change the world, one delectable bite at a time. (movie) - 2023

cinemax.us.title: Game Night
cinemax.us.description: Max and Annie's weekly game night gets kicked up a notch when Max's brother Brooks arranges a murder mystery party -- complete with fake thugs and federal agents. So when Brooks gets kidnapped, it's all supposed to be part of the game. As the competitors set out to solve the case, they start to learn that neither the game nor Brooks are what they seem to be. The friends soon find themselves in over their heads as each twist leads to another unexpected turn over the course of one chaotic night. (movie) - 2018

cinemax.us.title: The Sessions
cinemax.us.description: Though a childhood bout with polio left him dependent on an iron lung, Mark O'Brien (John Hawkes) maintains a career as a journalist and poet. A writing assignment dealing with sex and the disabled piques Mark's curiosity, and he decides to investigate the possibility of experiencing sex himself. When his overtures toward a caregiver (Annika Marks) scare her away, he books an appointment with sex surrogate Cheryl Cohen Green (Helen Hunt) to lose his virginity. (movie) - 2012

cinemax.us.title: The Nun
cinemax.us.description: When a young nun at a cloistered abbey in Romania takes her own life, a priest with a haunted past and a novitiate on the threshold of her final vows are sent by the Vatican to investigate. Together, they uncover the order's unholy secret. Risking not only their lives but their faith and their very souls, they confront a malevolent force in the form of a demonic nun. (movie) - 2018

cinemax.us.title: The Nun II
cinemax.us.description: An evil spreads in 1956 France as a priest is murdered, and Sister Irene once again comes face-to-face with the demonic nun Valak. (movie) - 2023

cinemax.us.title: On Becoming a Guinea Fowl
cinemax.us.description: On an empty road in the middle of the night, Shula stumbles across the body of her uncle. As the funeral unfolds, the cousins unveil the buried secrets of their Zambian family in a vibrant reckoning with the lies we tell ourselves. (movie) - 2024

cinemax.us.title: 3 Days to Kill
cinemax.us.description: Facing a terminal disease, spy Ethan Renner (Kevin Costner) has decided to give up his dangerous, high-stakes life in order to rebuild his relationship with his estranged wife and daughter (Hailee Steinfeld), whom he previously pushed away to keep them out of harm's way. However, in exchange for a potentially lifesaving drug, he must complete one final mission: apprehend one of the world's most ruthless terrorists while looking after his teenage offspring in her mother's absence. (movie) - 2014

cinemax.us.title: Enemy
cinemax.us.description: A mild-mannered college professor (Jake Gyllenhaal) discovers a look-alike actor and delves into the other man's private affairs. (movie) - 2013

cinemax.us.title: The Adjustment Bureau
cinemax.us.description: Just as he is on the brink of winning a Senate seat, politician David Norris meets a ballerina named Elise Sellas. Though David is instantly smitten, mysterious men conspire to keep him away from the beautiful dancer. David learns that he is facing the powerful agents of Fate itself, and glimpsing the future laid out for him, must either accept a predetermined path that does not include Elise or else defy Fate to be with her. (movie) - 2011

cinemax.us.title: Solace
cinemax.us.description: A psychic and a federal agent hunt a serial killer. (movie) - 2015

cinemax.us.title: Sherlock Holmes: A Game of Shadows
cinemax.us.description: When Austria's crown prince is found dead, evidence seems to point to suicide. However, detective Sherlock Holmes deduces that the prince was murdered and that the crime is but a piece of a puzzle designed by an evil genius named Moriarty. Holmes and his friend Dr. Watson, who are accompanied by a Gypsy whose life Holmes saved, chase Moriarty across Europe in the hope that they can thwart his plot before it can come to fruition. (movie) - 2011

cinemax.us.title: William Shakespeare's Romeo & Juliet
cinemax.us.description: Baz Luhrmann helped adapt this classic Shakespearean romantic tragedy for the screen, updating the setting to a post-modern city named Verona Beach. In this version, the Capulets and the Montagues are two rival gangs. Juliet is attending a costume ball thrown by her parents. Her father Fulgencio Capulet has arranged her marriage to the boorish Paris as part of a strategic investment plan. Romeo attends the masked ball and he and Juliet fall in love. (movie) - 1996

cinemax.us.title: Dumb Money
cinemax.us.description: Everyday people flip the script on Wall Street and get rich by turning GameStop into one of the world's hottest companies. In the middle of everything is Keith Gill, a regular guy who starts it all by sinking his life savings into the stock. When his social media posts start blowing up, so does his life and the lives of everyone following him. As a stock tip becomes a movement, everyone gets wealthy -- until the billionaires fight back and both sides find their worlds turned upside down. (movie) - 2023

cinemax.us.title: The Biggest Little Farm
cinemax.us.description: A couple are followed through their successes and failures as they work to develop a sustainable farm on 200 acres outside of Los Angeles. (movie) - 2018

cinemax.us.title: Rise of the Planet of the Apes

After his work is deemed a failure, Will becomes the guardian of Caesar, an infant chimp who was exposed in utero to Will's drug. Caesar displays unusual intelligence, and Will decides to continue his experiments secretly. But as Caesar's intellect and abilities grow, he comes to represent a threat to man's dominion over Earth. (movie) - 2011

cinemax.us.title: Dawn of the Planet of the Apes
cinemax.us.description: Ten years after simian flu wiped out much of the world's Homo sapiens, genetically enhanced chimpanzee Caesar and his ever-growing band of followers has established a thriving colony just outside San Francisco in Muir Woods. Meanwhile, a small band of human survivors emerges, which forces Caesar -- as leader -- to grapple with the dual challenge of protecting his people and re-establishing a relationship with the remaining human population -- the latter being Caesar's secret wish. (movie) - 2014

cinemax.us.title: War for the Planet of the Apes
cinemax.us.description: Caesar (Andy Serkis) and his apes are forced into a deadly conflict with an army of humans led by a ruthless colonel (Woody Harrelson). After the apes suffer unimaginable losses, Caesar wrestles with his darker instincts and begins his own mythic quest to avenge his kind. As the journey finally brings them face to face, Caesar and the colonel are pitted against each other in an epic battle that will determine the fate of both of their species and the future of the planet. (movie) - 2017

cinemaxaction.us.title: Batman Forever
cinemaxaction.us.description: Batman (Val Kilmer) faces off against two foes: the schizophrenic, horribly scarred former District Attorney Harvey Dent, aka Two-Face (Tommy Lee Jones), and the Riddler (Jim Carrey), a disgruntled ex-Wayne Enterprises inventor seeking revenge against his former employer by unleashing his brain-sucking weapon on Gotham City's residents. As the caped crusader also deals with tortured memories of his parents' murder, he has a new romance, with psychologist Chase Meridian (Nicole Kidman). (Action, Adventure, Crime, Fantasy, Movie) - 1995-06-16

cinemaxaction.us.title: Batman & Robin
cinemaxaction.us.description: This superhero adventure finds Batman (George Clooney) and his partner, Robin (Chris O'Donnell), attempting to the foil the sinister schemes of a deranged set of new villains, most notably the melancholy Mr. Freeze (Arnold Schwarzenegger), who wants to make Gotham into an arctic region, and the sultry Poison Ivy (Uma Thurman), a plant-loving femme fatale. As the Dynamic Duo contends with these bad guys, a third hero, Batgirl (Alicia Silverstone), joins the ranks of the city's crime-fighters. (Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Movie, Science Fiction) - 1997-06-20

cinemaxaction.us.title: Joker

Arthur wears two masks -- the one he paints for his day job as a clown, and the guise he projects in a futile attempt to feel like he's part of the world around him. Isolated, bullied and disregarded by society, Fleck begins a slow descent into madness as he transforms into the criminal mastermind known as the Joker. (Crime, Crime drama, Drama, Movie, Thriller) - 2019-08-31

(Adventure, Drama, Movie, Romance) - 2017-09-09

cinemaxaction.us.title: Parental Guidance

To their surprise, Alice and her husband (Tom Everett Scott) ask them to watch their children so they can embark on a trip for work. It promises to be a fun time for all, until the three young ones turn out to be quite a handful for this old-fashioned couple. Artie and Diane may need to bend the rules to make everyone happy in the end. (Children, Comedy, Movie) - 2012-12-25

cinemaxaction.us.title: A Clockwork Orange

As a storm cuts off power to the isolated cabin, the two men begin a jagged game that will bring at least one tale to an end. (Drama, Movie, Mystery, Thriller) - 2017-05-26

The father/son team must then battle giant insects, including praying mantises and a formidable spider. Can Godzilla protect his curious tike from the gargantuan bugs? (Adventure, Fantasy, Movie, Science Fiction, Science fiction) - 1967-12-16

Lee Ermey), and pudgy Private Lawrence (Vincent D'Onofrio), nicknamed "Gomer Pyle," as they endure the rigors of basic training. (Horror, Movie, Science Fiction, Science fiction, Thriller) - 1981-01-14

cinemaxclassics.us.description: A U.S. senator's son (Judge Reinhold) gets a job at a conglomerate and falls for the chairman's (Eddie Albert) radical daughter. (Comedy, Movie) - 1986

They are saved by a chance encounter with an Aborigine boy (David Gulpilil) who shows them how to survive, and in the process underscores the disharmony between nature and modern life. (Adventure, Drama, Movie) - 1971

(Comedy drama, Movie) - 2008

cinemaxclassics.us.title: The Last Emperor
cinemaxclassics.us.description: This sweeping account of the life of Pu Yi (John Lone), the last emperor of China, follows the leader's tumultuous reign. After being captured by the Red Army as a war criminal in 1950, Pu Yi recalls his childhood from prison. He remembers his lavish youth in the Forbidden City, where he was afforded every luxury but unfortunately sheltered from the outside world and complex political situation surrounding him. As revolution sweeps through China, the world Pu Yi knew is dramatically upended. (Biography, Drama, Historical drama, Movie) - 1987-11-18

cinemaxclassics.us.title: A History of Violence
cinemaxclassics.us.description: When a pair of petty criminals attempt to rob his small-town diner, Tom Stall (Viggo Mortensen) quickly and easily kills them both. In the flush of news coverage of Tom's seemingly heroic actions, a threatening stranger named Carl Fogarty (Ed Harris) comes to town, fingering the unassuming family man as long-missing Philadelphia mobster Joey Cusack. To the horror of his wife, Edie (Maria Bello), and teenage son, Jack (Ashton Holmes), Tom finds he must confront his violent past. (Crime, Drama, Movie, Thriller) - 2005-09-23

cinemaxclassics.us.title: The Usual Suspects

(Crime, Crime drama, Drama, Movie, Thriller) - 1995-08-16

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Mothra vs. Godzilla

(Russell Brand). But E.B. has no interest in the job and would rather be a drummer. He runs away to Los Angeles, where an unemployed slacker named Fred O'Hare (James Marsden) accidentally runs into him. Feigning injury, E.B. tricks Fred into giving him shelter, but an oversized chick is planning a coup back on Easter Island. (Animated, Animation, Comedy, Family, Holiday) - 2011-03-31

cinemaxclassics.us.title: It's Kind of a Funny Story

Unfortunately, the youth wing is closed, so he must spend his mandated five-day stay with adults. One of them, Bobby (Zach Galifianakis), quickly becomes his mentor -- and protege, while Craig finds himself drawn to a fellow teen, Noelle (Emma Roberts), who just may be the cure he needs to forget an unrequited crush. (Comedy, Comedy drama, Drama, Movie, Romance) - 2010-10-08

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Holla

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Odd Jobs

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Repo Men

But if they default on payments, an organization known as the Union sends agents to repossess the organs. Remy (Jude Law) is one of the best agents in the business, but when he becomes the recipient of an artificial heart, he finds himself in the same dire straits as his many victims. With his former partner (Forest Whitaker) in hot pursuit, Remy runs for his life. (Action, Crime, Movie, Science Fiction, Science fiction) - 2010-03-19

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Wedding Crashers

freeform.us.title: Dr. Seuss' The Grinch
freeform.us.description: The Grinch and his loyal dog, Max, live a solitary existence inside a cave on Mount Crumpet. His main source of aggravation comes during Christmastime when his neighbors in Whoville celebrate the holidays with a bang. When the Whos decide to make Christmas bigger and brighter, the disgruntled Grinch realizes there is one way to gain peace and quiet. With help from Max, the green grump hatches a scheme to pose as Santa Claus, steal Christmas and silence the Whos' holiday cheer once and for all. (Animated, Children, Holiday, Comedy, Adventure) - 2018

freeform.us.title: The Santa Clause
freeform.us.description: Divorced dad Scott (Tim Allen) has custody of his son (Eric Lloyd) on Christmas Eve. After he accidentally kills a man in a Santa suit, they are magically transported to the North Pole, where an elf explains that Scott must take Santa's place before the next Christmas arrives. Scott thinks he's dreaming, but over the next several months he gains weight and grows an inexplicably white beard. Maybe that night at the North Pole wasn't a dream after all -- and maybe Scott has a lot of work to do. (Family, Holiday, Comedy) - 1994

freeform.us.title: The Santa Clause 2
freeform.us.description: Scott Calvin (Tim Allen) has been in the role of Santa for the past eight years, and his loyal elves consider him the best one ever. But the world of the "Merry Old Soul" turns upside down when he's dealt a double whammy of news: Not only has his son, Charlie (Eric Lloyd), landed on this year's naughty list, but Scott discovers that he must marry by Christmas Eve -- just a month away! -- or he will stop being Santa Claus forever. (Family, Holiday, Comedy) - 2002

freeform.us.title: The Santa Clause 3: The Escape Clause
freeform.us.description: Christmas cheer turns into holiday chaos when Scott Calvin, aka Santa, invites his in-laws for a visit and must, simultaneously, contend with Jack Frost's scheme to take over the North Pole. Scott, his family and Head Elf Curtis must join forces to foil the nefarious plot. (Family, Holiday, Comedy) - 2006

freeform.us.title: Home Alone 2: Lost in New York

freeform.us.title: Tarzan
freeform.us.description: In this Disney animated tale, the orphaned Tarzan (Tony Goldwyn) grows up in the remote African wilderness, raised by the gentle gorilla Kala (Glenn Close). When a British expedition enters the jungle, Tarzan encounters the beautiful Jane (Minnie Driver) and recognizes that, like her, he's human. Falling in love with Jane, Tarzan is torn between embracing civilization and staying with his gorilla family, which becomes threatened by the ruthless hunter Clayton (Brian Blessed). (Animated, Children, Musical, Drama, Adventure) - 1999

freeform.us.title: The Lion King

Simba returns as an adult (Matthew Broderick) to take back his homeland from Scar with the help of his friends Timon (Nathan Lane) and Pumbaa (Ernie Sabella). After a malevolent enemy known as the Mandarin (Ben Kingsley) reduces his personal world to rubble, Tony must rely solely on instinct and ingenuity to avenge his losses and protect the people he loves. ifc.us.title: Lethal Weapon
ifc.us.description: Following the death of his wife, Los Angeles police detective Martin Riggs (Mel Gibson) becomes reckless and suicidal. When he is reassigned and partnered with Roger Murtaugh (Danny Glover), Riggs immediately clashes with the older officer. Together they uncover a massive drug-trafficking ring. As they encounter increasingly dangerous situations, Riggs and Murtaugh begin to form a bond. Riggs' volatile behavior might just help them apprehend the criminals -- if it doesn't kill them both first. (Action, Thriller) - 1987

ifc.us.title: Lethal Weapon 2
ifc.us.description: South African smugglers find themselves being hounded and harassed by Riggs and Murtaugh, two mismatched Los Angeles police officers. However, the South Africans are protected by diplomatic immunity, and so the two are assigned to witness-protection duty in an attempt by their captain to keep his job. It is only when this witness reveals to them that he has already dealt with the smugglers that the trouble really starts. (Action, Thriller) - 1989

ifc.us.title: Lethal Weapon 3
ifc.us.description: Veteran police detective Roger Murtaugh (Danny Glover) is only days away from retiring when he and his tough partner, Martin Riggs (Mel Gibson), are roped into an important internal affairs case. Working with the beautiful, no-nonsense Sergeant Lorna Cole (Rene Russo) and aided by the shifty informant Leo Getz (Joe Pesci), Murtaugh and Riggs begin to close in on a black-market weapons operation involving corrupt cop and arms dealer Jack Travis (Stuart Wilson). (Action, Thriller) - 1992

ifc.us.title: Lethal Weapon 4
ifc.us.description: Detective Riggs (Mel Gibson) tries to settle down with his pregnant girlfriend, Lorna (Rene Russo), while his partner, Murtaugh (Danny Glover), comes to grips with the marriage of his pregnant daughter, Rianne (Traci Wolfe), to fellow cop Butters (Chris Rock). But they find themselves and their families targeted by Chinese mobsters, led by Wah Sing Ku (Jet Li). Riggs, Murtaugh, Butters and private eye Getz (Joe Pesci) decide to go on the offensive before the gangsters get to their loved ones. (Action) - 1998

mgmplus.us.title: Platoon
mgmplus.us.description: Chris Taylor (Charlie Sheen) leaves his university studies to enlist in combat duty in Vietnam in 1967. Once he's on the ground in the middle of battle, his idealism fades. Infighting in his unit between Staff Sergeant Barnes (Tom Berenger), who believes nearby villagers are harboring Viet Cong soldiers, and Sergeant Elias (Willem Dafoe), who has a more sympathetic view of the locals, ends up pitting the soldiers against each other as well as against the enemy. (War, Drama) - 1986

mgmplus.us.title: Flags of Our Fathers
mgmplus.us.description: In February and March 1945, U.S. troops fight and win one of the most crucial and costly battles of the war on the island of Iwo Jima. A photo of U.S. servicemen raising the flag on Mount Suribachi becomes an iconic symbol of victory to a war-weary nation. The individuals themselves become heroes, though not all survive the war and realize it. (War, Historical drama) - 2006

mgmplus.us.title: Valkyrie
mgmplus.us.description: Col. Claus von Stauffenberg serves Germany with loyalty and pride but fears that Hitler will destroy his country if allowed to run unchecked. With time running out for Germany and the rest of Europe, von Stauffenberg joins a group of like-minded, high-ranking men who want to overthrow the Nazi regime from within. With everything he holds dear in the balance, von Stauffenberg becomes the trigger man in a plot to assassinate the evil dictator. (movie) - 2008

mgmplus.us.title: U-571
mgmplus.us.description: When a German U-571 submarine with a sophisticated encryption machine onboard is sunk during a World War II battle at sea, the Allies send an American Navy force led by Lieutenant Andrew Tyler (Matthew McConaughey) to retrieve it for study. Boarding the German ship, the Americans' cover as a rescue force is quickly blown. Forced to take the crew hostage, the Americans lay their explosives and prepare to destroy the German vessel before the Nazis can send naval backup. (movie) - 2000

mgmplus.us.title: Full Metal Jacket
mgmplus.us.description: Stanley Kubrick's take on the Vietnam War follows smart-aleck Private Davis (Matthew Modine), quickly christened "Joker" by his foul-mouthed drill sergeant (R. Lee Ermey), and pudgy Private Lawrence (Vincent D'Onofrio), nicknamed "Gomer Pyle," as they endure the rigors of basic training. Though Pyle takes a frightening detour, Joker graduates to the Marine Corps and is sent to Vietnam as a journalist, covering -- and eventually participating in -- the bloody Battle of Hue. (movie) - 1987

mgmplus.us.title: We Were Soldiers
mgmplus.us.description: Based upon the best-selling book "We Were Soldiers Once ... and Young" by Lt. Gen. Harold G. Moore (Ret.) and journalist Joseph L. Galloway, this compelling war drama depicts the true story of the first major battle between the United States and North Vietnamese forces. It is a film about uncommon valor and nobility under fire, loyalty among soldiers, and the heroism and sacrifice of men and women both home and abroad. (movie) - 2002

mgmplus.us.title: There's Something Wrong With the Children
mgmplus.us.description: Margaret and Ben take a weekend trip with two longtime friends and their two young children. Ben soon suspects something sinister is afoot when the kids start behaving strangely after disappearing into the woods overnight. (movie) - 2023

mgmplus.us.title: Sunset Boulevard
mgmplus.us.description: An aging silent film queen refuses to accept that her stardom has ended. She hires a young screenwriter to help set up her movie comeback. The screenwriter believes he can manipulate her, but he soon finds out he is wrong. The screenwriter's ambivalence about their relationship and her unwillingness to let go leads to a situation of violence, madness, and death. (movie) - 1950

mgmplus.us.title: Protector

mgmplus.us.title: Biker Boyz
mgmplus.us.description: Slick Will, the mechanic for a legendary motorcycle racer named Smoke (Laurence Fishburne), is struck dead during an off-the-grid race. Following the funeral, and in opposition to his mother's protests, Slick Will's son, Kid (Derek Luke), starts racing in the same fringe circuit -- but, despite Kid's skill and showmanship, Smoke refuses to race him. Spurned by the man he looked up to, Kid starts a rival motorcycle gang called the Biker Boyz, and a showdown between them is inevitable. (movie) - 2003

mgmplus.us.title: Cop Land
mgmplus.us.description: When hotheaded Superboy (Michael Rapaport) accidentally gets involved in an ugly racially-motivated incident, his uncle Ray Donlan (Harvey Keitel), a corrupt New York City cop, attempts to sweep it under the rug by helping fake his nephew's death. The bungled cover-up leads to investigations by idealistic Internal Affairs officer Moe Tilden (Robert De Niro) and Freddy Heflin (Sylvester Stallone), sheriff of the suburban New Jersey town where Donlan and his fellow crooked policemen live. (movie) - 1997

mgmplus.us.title: Wildcat

mgmplus.us.title: G.I. Joe: The Rise of Cobra
mgmplus.us.description: Armed with the latest in military and spy technology, the team of elite soldiers known as G.I. Joe travel around the globe to wherever their services are needed. In their latest assignment Gen. Hawk (Dennis Quaid), Duke (Channing Tatum) and the rest of the G.I. Joe team take on Destro (Christopher Eccleston), a corrupt arms dealer, and fight the growing threat of the mysterious Cobra organization. (movie) - 2009

mgmplus.us.title: G.I. Joe: Retaliation

Cotrona, Lee Byung-hun) face a two-fold threat. Not only is their mortal enemy COBRA rearing its ugly head again, but there is also a threat from within the U.S. government: There might be an impostor in the White House. Meanwhile, Snake Eyes (Ray Park) is on a search for inner peace but learns that his nemesis, Storm Shadow, is still alive. (movie) - 2013

Meanwhile, meddling Don John (Keanu Reeves) plots to ruin the wedding. (movie) - 1993

movies.us.description: During the 1972 Munich Olympics, an American sports broadcasting crew finds itself thrust into covering the hostage crisis involving Israeli athletes. (movie) - 2024

movies.us.title: True Grit
movies.us.description: After an outlaw named Tom Chaney murders her father, feisty 14-year-old farm girl Mattie Ross hires Rooster Cogburn, a boozy, trigger-happy lawman, to help her find Chaney and avenge her father. The bickering duo are not alone in their quest, for a Texas Ranger named LaBoeuf is also tracking Chaney for reasons of his own. Together the unlikely trio ventures into hostile territory to dispense some Old West justice. (movie) - 2010

movies.us.title: No Country for Old Men
movies.us.description: While out hunting, Llewelyn Moss (Josh Brolin) finds the grisly aftermath of a drug deal. Though he knows better, he cannot resist the cash left behind and takes it with him. The hunter becomes the hunted when a merciless killer named Chigurh (Javier Bardem) picks up his trail. Also looking for Moss is Sheriff Bell (Tommy Lee Jones), an aging lawman who reflects on a changing world and a dark secret of his own, as he tries to find and protect Moss. (movie) - 2007

movies.us.title: No Country for Old Men

movies.us.title: There Will Be Blood
movies.us.description: Silver miner Daniel Plainview (Daniel Day-Lewis) leads a hardscrabble life with his son, H.W. (Dillon Freasier). When he hears about oil oozing from the ground near the Western town of Little Boston, Daniel takes his son on a mission to find their fortune. Daniel makes his lucky strike and becomes a self-made tycoon but, as his fortune grows, he deviates into moral bankruptcy. (movie) - 2007

movies.us.title: Gangs of New York
movies.us.description: Amsterdam Vallon (Leonardo DiCaprio) is a young Irish immigrant released from prison. He returns to the Five Points seeking revenge against his father's killer, William Cutting (Daniel Day-Lewis), a powerful anti-immigrant gang leader. He knows that revenge can only be attained by infiltrating Cutting's inner circle. Amsterdam's journey becomes a fight for personal survival and to find a place for the Irish people in the 1860's New York. (movie) - 2002

movies.us.title: The Godfather
movies.us.description: Widely regarded as one of the greatest films of all time, this mob drama, based on Mario Puzo's novel of the same name, focuses on the powerful Italian-American crime family of Don Vito Corleone (Marlon Brando). When the don's youngest son, Michael (Al Pacino), reluctantly joins the Mafia, he becomes involved in the inevitable cycle of violence and betrayal. Although Michael tries to maintain a normal relationship with his wife, Kay (Diane Keaton), he is drawn deeper into the family business. (movie) - 1972

movies.us.title: The Godfather Part II
movies.us.description: The compelling sequel to "The Godfather," contrasting the life of Corleone father and son. Traces the problems of Michael Corleone (Al Pacino) in 1958 and that of a young immigrant Vito Corleone (Robert De Niro) in 1917's Hell's Kitchen. Michael survives many misfortunes and Vito is introduced to a life of crime. (movie) - 1974

screenpix.us.title: Extremities
screenpix.us.description: Marjorie (Farrah Fawcett) manages to fight off a rapist and flee to safety. Because her attacker got away and Marjorie has no proof of the crime, police officers tell her there is little they can do. Because Marjorie's attacker also stole her purse, she fears that he will use its contents to track her down. When Joe (James Russo) does show up at Marjorie's house to finish what he started, he discovers that Marjorie is not the fragile victim he imagined. (Drama) - 1986

screenpix.us.title: A Cold Wind in August
screenpix.us.description: A 28-year-old stripper (Lola Albright) on vacation seduces the 17-year-old son (Scott Marlowe) of her New York building's superintendent. (Drama) - 1961

screenpix.us.title: Monkey on My Back
screenpix.us.description: In this fact-based film, star prizefighter Barney Ross (Cameron Mitchell) puts his career on hold to fight in World War II. He soon distinguishes himself through his courageous service, but later becomes infected with malaria. He is sent home and treated with morphine, to which he soon becomes addicted. As he descends further into the throes of his deadly habit, his courageous wife, Cathy (Dianne Foster), vows to help her husband kick his addiction before it kills him. (Biography) - 1957

screenpix.us.title: Madhouse
screenpix.us.description: The career of horror icon Paul Toombes (Vincent Price) ends in scandal when his fiancée dies under mysterious circumstances. Freed from the mental hospital where he had been committed, the recovered Toombes and screenwriter Herbert Flay (Peter Cushing) intend to revive his most popular character, Dr. Death, for a television series. But the dead bodies start piling up -- all of them killed in ways that mimic the victims in Toombes' films -- and to clear his name he must find the real killer. (Horror) - 1974

screenpix.us.title: The Premature Burial
screenpix.us.description: Based on Edgar Allan Poe's story about a cataleptic Englishman obsessed with the fear of being buried alive. (Horror) - 1962

screenpix.us.title: The First Power
screenpix.us.description: A Los Angeles policeman (Lou Diamond Phillips) hunts a killer (Jeff Kober) brought back from the gas chamber by Satan. (Horror) - 1990

screenpix.us.title: The Fall of the House of Usher
screenpix.us.description: Based on the classic story "The Fall of the House of Usher" by Edgar Allan Poe and directed by legendary filmmaker Roger Corman, this thriller features Vincent Price as Roderick Usher, a man who believes his family to be cursed by incurable madness. So sure is he of his family's doom, that when his sister Madeline (Myrna Fahey) announces her engagement to Philip Winthrop (Mark Damon), Roderick will stop at nothing to prevent their marriage and keep the Usher bloodline from continuing. (Horror) - 1960

screenpix.us.title: The Ghost of Sierra de Cobre
screenpix.us.description: Vivia Mandore, an heiress, enlists the services of a paranormal investigator to look into a suspected case of haunting involving the spirit of her deceased mother-in-law. (Horror, Mystery, Thriller) - 1964

screenpix.us.title: The Black Sleep
screenpix.us.description: Victorian Sir Joel (Basil Rathbone) prepares for his wife's brain surgery by practicing on locals supplied by a Gypsy (Akim Tamiroff). (Horror, Science fiction) - 1956

screenpix.us.title: The Young Doctors
screenpix.us.description: After arriving to his new post in a hospital pathology department, Dr. David Coleman (Ben Gazzara) clashes with the department head, Dr. Pearson (Fredric March). Pearson, who views Coleman as competition, thinks the young doctor is too brash. The older doctor does not agree with Coleman's suggestion to test a pregnant mother for a blood disease. When the baby is born very sick, and it becomes clear that Coleman was correct, Pearson must assess his place in the hospital. (Drama) - 1961

screenpix.us.title: Her Best Move
screenpix.us.description: Encouraged by her best friend (Lalaine), a 15-year-old soccer prodigy (Leah Pipes) learns to live like a normal teenager. (Comedy) - 2007

screenpix.us.title: The Delinquents
screenpix.us.description: Good-hearted teen Scotty (Tom Laughlin) just wants to spend time with his girl, but her disapproving folks break up the young lovers' relationship. Scotty grows despondent but bumps into fellow youngsters Cholly (Peter Miller) and Eddy (Richard Bakalyan), who cheer him up with their mischievous ways. They induct Scotty into their band of hooligans, but the group's harmless rock-'n'-roll-fueled antics quickly give way to violent rumbles at drive-ins, and Scotty winds up in major trouble. (Crime drama) - 1957

screenpix.us.title: Music Within
screenpix.us.description: After a confrontation with one of his idols dashes his dreams of studying public speaking in college, Richard Pimentel joins the Army and ships off to Vietnam. During his service, Richard loses nearly all of his hearing. Joining a new circle of friends, including a man with cerebral palsy and an alcoholic war veteran, Richard discovers his gift for motivational speaking and becomes an advocate for people with disabilities. (Drama) - 2007

screenpix.us.title: The Captive City
screenpix.us.description: A private investigator informs small-town newspaper editor Jim Austin of corrupt local activity. When the investigator is killed, Austin believes it's an act of revenge, and his own detective work reveals a network of gambling and corruption. Crime boss Murray Sirak controls the whole town, including the police. Sirak answers to his own boss, "Mr. Big," who is seemingly untouchable, but Austin risks his life to expose the truth. (Crime drama) - 1952

screenpix.us.title: Shield for Murder
screenpix.us.description: Corrupt cop Barney Nolan (Edmond O'Brien) is hard up for cash, so he shoots a bookie, relieves him of $25,000 and makes it look like an accident. Unbeknownst to Nolan, however, the entire episode is witnessed by a deaf-mute from across the street. While Nolan struggles to keep the crime a secret from his girlfriend, Patty Winters (Marla English), a series of loose ends pop up, and Nolan soon learns that, although committing a crime is easy, getting away with it is murder. (Crime drama) - 1954

screenpix.us.title: The Organization
screenpix.us.description: When an executive and a night watchman are killed in a San Francisco office building, Lt. Virgil Tibbs is called in to investigate and discovers the watchman was actually killed elsewhere. Soon Tibbs is contacted by urban revolutionaries who confess to kidnapping -- but not killing -- the watchman in a botched attempt to expose a heroin ring operating out of the building. Tibbs believes them, but when his superiors learn of his ties to the group, he's suspended from the force. (Action, Crime drama, Thriller) - 1971

screenpix.us.title: Vice Raid
screenpix.us.description: New York mobsters use a Detroit prostitute (Mamie Van Doren) to set up a vice-squad detective (Richard Coogan). (Crime drama) - 1959

screenpix.us.title: The Big Boodle
screenpix.us.description: Cuban crooks and police chase a casino card dealer (Errol Flynn) for counterfeit pesos and plates. (Crime drama) - 1957

screenpix.us.title: One Thrilling Night
screenpix.us.description: Honeymooners (John Beal, Wanda McKay) find gangsters searching for money in their New York hotel room. (Comedy) - 1942

screenpix.us.title: The Hoodlum Priest
screenpix.us.description: Venturing into some of the roughest slums of St. Louis, Jesuit priest Rev. Charles Dismas Clark (Don Murray) dedicates himself to helping young ex-convicts who are struggling to rejoin a society that fears and rejects them. An especially wrenching case for the Reverend is Billy Lee Jackson (Keir Dullea), a troubled thief whose personal demons constantly tempt him back to a life of crime -- and may ultimately make him pay the highest price for a few desperate decisions. (Biography) - 1961

screenpix.us.title: Kid Colter
screenpix.us.description: In the mountains of the Pacific Northwest, young Justin Colter (Jeremy Shamos) gets caught in the middle of a chase between two groups of spies. They kidnap him and eventually leave him for dead in the forest. But Justin's father, Bill (Jim Stafford), trained his boy to survive in the wild. Using the skills taught to him by his father, Justin fights against the harsh elements and wild animals of the mountains to make his way back home and reunite with his worried family. (Adventure) - 1985

screenpix.us.title: Sea Fury
screenpix.us.description: The first mate (Stanley Baker) of a British salvage boat rivals his captain (Victor McLaglen) for a Spanish girl (Luciana Paluzzi). (Adventure, Action, Drama) - 1958

Virgil Tibbs is called in to investigate and discovers the watchman was actually killed elsewhere. Soon Tibbs is contacted by urban revolutionaries who confess to kidnapping -- but not killing -- the watchman in a botched attempt to expose a heroin ring operating out of the building. Tibbs believes them, but when his superiors learn of his ties to the group, he's suspended from the force. (Action, Crime drama, Thriller) - 1971

screenpix.us.title: Vice Raid
screenpix.us.description: New York mobsters use a Detroit prostitute (Mamie Van Doren) to set up a vice-squad detective (Richard Coogan). (Crime drama) - 1959

screenpixaction.us.title: Marshal Law
screenpixaction.us.description: In the wake of a devastating earthquake, a former U.S. marshal (Jimmy Smits) fights thugs terrorizing an isolated Los Angeles community. (Thriller) - 1996

screenpixaction.us.title: Killing Streets
screenpixaction.us.description: When he's informed that his twin brother has died in Beirut, basketball coach Craig Brandt (Michael Paré) flies to Lebanon to investigate for himself. His brother was a U.S. Marine who, according to the military, died in an explosion during an anti-terrorist operation. At the U.S. Embassy, Craig meets with Charles Wolf (Lorenzo Lamas), who backs up the official story. Nevertheless, Craig has the uncanny feeling that his brother is still alive -- and that he's the only one who can save him. (Action) - 1991

screenpixaction.us.title: The Angry Red Planet
screenpixaction.us.description: Chief Warrant Officer Sam Jacobs (Jack Kruschen), Dr. Iris Ryan (Nora Hayden), Professor Theodore Gettell (Les Tremayne) and Col. Tom O'Bannion (Gerald Mohr) are astronauts aboard the spaceship MR-1, the first mission to Mars. Shortly after their rocket reaches the mysterious red planet, the band of brave space explorers discovers monstrous yet highly intelligent alien life forms, which first attack, then deliver a haunting word of warning intended for all mankind. (movie) - 1959

screenpixaction.us.title: Invisible Invaders
screenpixaction.us.description: When Dr. Karol Noymann (John Carradine) is killed in an explosion, aliens inhabit his corpse and use it to communicate with his former colleague, Dr. Adam Penner (Philip Tonge), revealing to him that invisible aliens live on the moon. After this revelation, the aliens set out to wipe out humanity by making zombies from their corpses. To survive, Dr. Penner, his daughter (Jean Byron), Dr. John Lamont (Robert Hutton) and Maj. Bruce Jay (John Agar) all hide in a bunker. (movie) - 1959

screenpixaction.us.title: Attack of the Puppet People
screenpixaction.us.description: Secretary Sally Reynolds (June Kenny) is grateful to her seemingly kind boss, Mr. Franz (John Hoyt), when he introduces her to a dapper young man, Bob (John Agar). Little does she know that Franz is more than a doll maker. Really, he is really a merciless mad scientist who fights off loneliness by shrinking people and forcing them to serve as his living dolls. But, when he shrinks Sally and her new beau, they refuse to be his playthings and escape into a dangerous world that towers over them. (movie) - 1958

screenpixaction.us.title: The Monster That Challenged the World
screenpixaction.us.description: An earthquake doesn't just shake up Southern California -- it awakens a nest of monsters lurking in the Salton Sea. These bloodthirsty sea snails are gobbling up anyone who sets foot in the water. And when the creatures move on to land in search of wider hunting grounds, they launch a reign of terror that threatens to spread across the whole country. Humanity's only hope rests on a crew of intrepid scientists and Lt. Cmdr. John Willinger (Tim Holt). (movie) - 1957

screenpixaction.us.title: The Man From Planet X
screenpixaction.us.description: From his observatory, Scottish professor Elliot (Raymond Bond) keeps close watch on Planet X, whose orbit is coming close to Earth. During the planet's approach, an alien ambassador appears but falls prey to maniacal scientist Dr. Mears (William Schallert). Returning the distinct lack of hospitality, the extraterrestrial uses his otherworldly powers to turn those he encounters into mindless drones. Elliot tries to stop the creature before everyone is turned into a zombie. (movie) - 1951

screenpixaction.us.title: The Beast With a Million Eyes
screenpixaction.us.description: An alien lands by spaceship and makes birds, cows and other animals attack a ranch family. (movie) - 1955

screenpixaction.us.title: Lord of Illusions
screenpixaction.us.description: Private eye Harry D'Amour travels to Los Angeles and meets with a new client, Dorothea Swann. Swann reveals that she and her husband — famed magician Philip Swann — have been targeted by a religious cult experimenting with reincarnation. After Philip dies on stage in the midst of a dangerous trick, D'Amour must struggle to protect Dorothea from the ruthless cult members and their newly reanimated religious leader, Nix. (movie) - 1995

screenpixaction.us.title: Vampires on Bikini Beach
screenpixaction.us.description: Californians (Jennifer Badham, Todd Kaufman) try to save their beach from a ghoul and his gang. (movie) - 1988

screenpixaction.us.title: Secret of Deep Harbor
screenpixaction.us.description: A reporter (Ron Foster) covers the waterfront and catches his girlfriend's (Merry Anders) father (Barry Kelley) smuggling gangsters. (movie) - 1961

screenpixaction.us.title: Raiders of the Seven Seas
screenpixaction.us.description: A fierce pirate, Barbarossa (John Payne) captures a Spanish ship with bravado. Discovering the beautiful Contessa Alida (Donna Reed) on board, Barbarossa falls for the elegant aristocrat, but she is to wed the sailor Jose Salcedo (Gerald Mohr). Although Alida is resistant to Barbarossa's charms, she slowly warms up to him, particularly after she discovers that Salcedo is not the man that she thought he was. Naturally, Barbarossa proceeds to sort things out with a series of sword battles. (movie) - 1953

screenpixaction.us.title: The Living Ghost
screenpixaction.us.description: When wealthy banker Walter Craig (Gus Glassmire) disappears, former private eye Nick Trayne (James Dunn) comes out of retirement to find the missing man. As Nick gets to know the contentious Craig family, the rich man reappears, but someone has put him in an unresponsive, zombie-like state. Then a member of the family is found stabbed to death, with Walter standing over him. When Walter attacks Nick, it seems that the catatonic banker is the killer, but Nick thinks there is more to the mystery. (movie) - 1942

screenpixaction.us.title: Ghost of Dragstrip Hollow
screenpixaction.us.description: Lois Cavendish (Jody Fair) hangs out at a nearby soda shop with her drag racing club. But when she learns the shop might be closed, she calls her wealthy aunt, Anastasia (Dorothy Neumann), for help. Anastasia offers the club the chance to use her mansion as their headquarters -- but with one strange condition: They have to scare away the ghost that haunts her home. When the club decides to throw an all-night monster mash party at the mansion, it becomes clear that something is amiss. (movie) - 1959
