ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E9 The Treasure Of El Bravo After Enrique steals the heart of El Bravo, there's only one person who can help Santi and crew save the day: Tomas's younger sister, Prima Tina!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Peppa Pig
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S0 E6 Peppa Pig: Peppa's Pumpkin Party Daddy Pig is throwing a special party. Everyone is invited, and they are all dressing in scary costumes. Peppa is a witch, George is a dinosaur, Rebecca Rabbit is a carrot gone bad!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Peppa Pig: The Golden Boots
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: Mrs Duck seems to have taken a liking to Peppa's golden boots and runs away with them! Can Peppa track down the golden boots before the big puddle jump competition?

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: The Tree Of Wisdom
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E1 The Rattlin' Bog Dance along with him and the Little Tree of Wisdom and then learn about hula hooping! Can you shake your hips and give it a go? And don't miss the remix of the hit song 'The Rattlin' Bog'!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Nikhil & Jay
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E15 Nikhil and Jay and the Lucky Striker When Jay plays carrom with Ammamma's lucky striker he can finally beat Amma! But when Jay loses the lucky striker his winning streak ends. Nikhil has a plan to help his brother!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Millie Magnificent
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E41 The Most Magnificent Pet Show Millie, Ben and Maya set out to teach Ying Ying a flying trick for the pet show in the park.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Stan & Gran
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E12 Hole in the Fence Strange holes in garden fences are popping up all over Porthole and Stink has gone missing! Stan and Gran spy a mystery and decide to investigate.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Miffy and Friends
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E37 Mini Miffy Miffy's delight at being imitated by Baby Bun turns to frustration when his constant mimicry interferes with her dance recital practice, leading her on a journey to understand the joys and challenges of being a big sister!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Mittens & Pants
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E31 Mayor Mittens When Mayor Sourdough appoints Mittens as mayor of Kibble Corners (just while he takes a nap, mind you) everything goes wrong very fast.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Mittens & Pants
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E32 Puppy Party Pants worries that having adoptive bunny parents might not make him puppy enough for a puppy party.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Ready, Steady, Wiggle!
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S6 E7 Simon's Rosy Arrangement Simon is crafting a floral arrangement for Dorothy the Dinosaur, but his roses vanish when he steps away to get some water. Caterina calls Fiore Enzo, the detective specialist for help!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Mini Kids
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E6 Today Fantus meets a pigeon, a rat and a badger.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Thomas & Friends
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E9 Percy's Lucky Bell When Thomas borrows Percy's lucky bell for a dangerous delivery, Thomas isn't careful and loses the bell.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Peppa Pig
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S6 E12 Grandpa Pig's Metal Detector When George loses his wind-up robot's metal key, Grandpa Pig uses his metal detector to find it and finds a lot of other things on the way.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Peppa Pig
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S6 E13 World Book Day It is World Book Day at playgroup but Peppa has so many favourite books she just cannot decide which to go as.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Shaun the Sheep
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E25 Shaun The Farmer The Farmer is sick in bed, so, with Bitzer playing nurse-maid, it's down to Shaun to handle the daily chores around the farm - with disastrous results.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Ginger and the Vegesaurs
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E5 Chillipede Chase Split chases a glowing Chillipede into the depths of the Spooky Forest and gets lost inside an overgrown tree-root maze, where the only way out is to follow the sounds of Ginger and the other Baby Pea-Rexes.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Ben & Holly's Little Kingdom
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E1 Giants in the Meadow Lucy's dad is digging up the meadow and the Little Kingdom is in danger.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Flower & Flour
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E3 Hectic Robot When a robotic toy duck is left at the restaurant, Flower becomes obsessed. Meanwhile, Flour the cat struggles to compete with the quacking newcomer for her attention.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Superkitties
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E26 Tiny Trouble When Cat Burglar shrinks Buddy on his way to steal musical instruments, Buddy learns that he doesn't have to be big to be super.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Santiago of the Seas
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E45 The Kitty Cat Caper Bonnie's cat tricks the crew into thinking he's a good pirate, but then they realize he's actually after their treasure.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: PJ Masks
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S4 E23 Gekko Vs Armavillian Desperate to prove himself, Gekko recruits Armadylan for extra training.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: The Octonauts
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S3 E20 The Octonauts And Hammerhead Sharks The Octonauts study a group of baby hammerhead sharks, as they hunt on their own for the first time and poke their noses into trouble.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Hey Duggee
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E38 The Sand Castle Badge It's a lovely warm day for the beach. The squirrels learn how to make sand castles. They are doing such a good job that Jon and Nigel the crabs ask if the squirrels could work together to build them a new home.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Kangaroo Beach
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S3 E12 Dad Rescue When Frizzy's dad gets into trouble in the mountains, Frizzy steps up to lead the rescue mission and save the day!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Fireman Sam
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S13 E6 Too Many Peas, Too Many Plugs When Dilys overloads a socket at the Cut Price Store and starts a fire, Mandy learns that every job on the Fire Rescue team is the most important job!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Nikhil & Jay
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E48 Nikhil and Jay and the Sneezies When Amma gets the sneezies, Nikhil and Jay are worried that it's Max's fault. They try to stop their cat from being sent away.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Numberblocks
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S4 E4 What's My Number? Welcome to the game show where you don't count, you see the amount! Join the Numberblocks and learn how to recognise numbers of things without counting them.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: The Makery
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E13 Laundry Day Nim makes a sock gobbling monster by recycling an old box. Once the washing is done, she cooks focaccia flowers and creates a puppet mouse out of old clothes.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Fizzy And Suds
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E20 Cows Fizzy and Suds spend time with some gorgeous country cows and even see them being milked. It's also showtime - and our bubbly friends get to meet some prize-winners. MOO MOOOOO!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Play School
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: E18 Everyday Helpers: 3 Abi and Luke meet Ben, a friendly and helpful nurse! Luke uses craft materials to make his own stethoscope, and Jemima visits Dr Kiya at hospital for an x-ray! Through The Windows, we see more medical workers in an animation.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: The Highway Rat
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: An animated swash-buckler based on the much-loved children's book written by Julia Donaldson and illustrated by Axel Scheffler. The tale of a greedy rat who craves buns and biscuits, but comes to a sticky end.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Little J And Big Cuz
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S4 E1 Two Truths Little J is torn between Ms Chen and Nanna's knowledge.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Andy and the Band
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S5 E2 Dinosaur Football It's time to get back to Rock Star School. But with Evil Aliens, Dinosaurs, Football and Cheesy Puffs, Andy faces a tough task to keep everyone from getting distracted.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Dodge's Pup School
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E2 The Class Star Dodge is eager to win the Class Star award, but how will he out shine Cherry the superstar at everything? Dodge discovers that the real key to winning the Class Star award is by trying his best.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Flower & Flour
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E17 Sleepyhead Dirk promises to read Flower and Flour a bedtime story but when he's too tired to continue, Flower has to step in and invent her own bedtime story.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Gardening Australia Junior
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E20 Sensory Garden Hannah works with two brothers to create a garden that delights all of the senses. Alfie is vision impaired and loves being active and playing, so they create a garden of games he can enjoy with his brother, William.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Peppa Pig
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S10 E5 Granny Sheep Moves In Suzy's grandma, Granny Sheep, moves into her house for the first time ever.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Peppa Pig
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S8 E6 Cardboard Boxes Peppa and her friends have fun playing with boxes.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: It's Andrew!
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E22 Big BIG Lifty Pod Andrew's fear of heights stops him from riding the Lifty Pod - but he doesn't want to miss out on hill sliding with his friends. So, when the littlecorns share how they face their fears, Andrew finds a way to be brave, too.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Thomas & Friends: Sodor Sings Together
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: In preparation for the big Sodor Sings Festival - the biggest musical event on the - the engines are hard at work to make the night one to remember.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Bluey
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E16 Yoga Ball Bingo loves horsing around with Dad, but sometimes he forgets Bingo is smaller than her sister. Mum teaches Bingo how to use her big girl bark to keep their fun within her limits.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Zog
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E26 Gadabout Blabbermouth Winton doesn't want anyone to know about his tummy troubles but Gadabout struggles to keep the news to himself.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: MaeBee
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E2 Mae, Bee and the Bearded Bake While helping at Lesley's bakery, Mae, Bee and friends eat some magical buns of ageing, becoming 500yrs old. A rare four-leaf clover is the only cure, that's if they can catch it!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Superbuns
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E31 Moment of Tooth After reading comics, Buns is convinced a super carrot will give her superpowers. But rescuing her sister Blossom's lost tooth is what makes her a true superhero!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Superkitties
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E7 Super-Fan SuperKitty super-fan, Pickles, helps the team save the day.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Do Not Watch This Show
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E4 Space Creature When Wizz finds a friendly Space Creature on his couch, he has no choice but to try and help her get back to her home before the Fun Suckers find her and put her in space prison.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Bluey
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E16 Army Jack's the new dog at school and the newest recruit in Rusty's army. Jack struggles with following instructions and always forgets his hat,Â but Rusty will make a soldier of him yet.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Little Lunch
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E7 The Milk Bar Rory has forgotten his lunch, again, and the other children have had enough. They refuse to give him any more of their food. Rory is starving and, in desperation, decides to go to the milk bar.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Crookhaven
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E7 The Trials The Crooklings compete at the cutthroat Trials, with the eyes of the Crooked world watching. The Nameless spy resorts to desperate measures. Jia leads the search for Amira.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Are You Afraid of the Dark?
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E4 The Tale of the Danse Macabre On the eve of the school dance, the Midnight Society wrestles with the possibility that evil still lurks among them and the nightmare is far from over.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: The Secret Life Of Bees
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E2 Steve finds out about the importance of Britain's wild bees and discovers exactly how the National Bee Unit are trying to eradicate the dreaded Asian hornet - a bee-eating machine - from the UK.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Mythbusters: There's Your Problem!
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E7 Zapped The MythBusters test if you can be electrocuted by lightning while talking on the phone; if a stun-gun could use water instead of wires; and if peeing on the electrified rail of a subway line could give you a fatal shock.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: The Slow Mo Guys' Big Adventures
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E7 Vikings This time The Slow Mo Guys go conquering and look at the amazing world of Vikings. What happens when strong Viking swords strike together?

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Robot Wars
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S8 E6 Grand Final The heat winners in shows 1 to 5 come back to fight again. The judges must choose one Wild Card from the runners-up to join them. Every team left standing battles it out to make it to the grand final of Robot Wars.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Young Sheldon
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S7 E3 A Strudel and a Hot American Boy Toy Sheldon explores Germany behind Mary's back, Missy attempts to pull a fast one on George Sr. and Meemaw and Dale adjust to living together.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: BTN High
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: E66 Raheim Brown Jr 16-year-old 'RJ' Brown Jnr has just made his NBL debut as a Development Player for the Adelaide 36ers. We find out what it's like to be youngest player signed by an NBL club in more than 40 years.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Pokemon: Ruby and Sapphire
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S7 E38 Cruisin' For a Losin' May decides to use Bulbasaur in the Rubello Town Contest. Will its lack of experience cost her a ribbon?

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Dragon Ball Super
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E49 A Message From The Future The Incursion Of Goku Black! After regaining consciousness, Future Trunks describes how he came to arrive in the present. But apparently not even the gods are allowed to meddle with the past. Bulma and Future Trunks might have a bit of explaining to do.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Miraculous: Tales Of Ladybug And Cat Noir
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S4 E12 Crocoduel Because of a plan thought up by Marinette, Shadow Moth akumatizes two villains. Ladybug and Cat Noir will need help to stop the evil duo!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: We Bare Bears
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E25 Baby Bears Can't Jump Charlie hosts an evening of spooky stories.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: We Bare Bears
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S3 E10 Laser Royale The Baby Bears sign up for a game of laser tag.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Teen Titans Go!
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E36 Truth, Justice, and What? The true source of the Titans' goofy humour: pizza!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Teen Titans Go!
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S6 E13 Record Book Starfire wants a world record, so she decides to grow her fingernails.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Teen Titans Go!
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S7 E22 Fat Cats After winning a huge cash prize, the Titans learn about the IRS and taxes.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Total Dramarama
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E32 OWW When the kids discover Chef's past as a disgraced pro wrestler, they invite his old tag team partner to help put on a charity show. But is the big match about re-union or re-venge?!?

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: The Powerpuff Girls
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E28 The Big Sleep The Professor's latest invention wreaks havoc.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Adventure Time
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E23 Rainy Day Daydream Jake's imagination runs wild and Finn has to stop it before it kills them.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Malory Towers
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S4 E9 The Strong Heart Clarissa receives a letter from her father, he is writing to inform her that he has sold her pony, Merrylegs, because Clarissa isn't well enough to ride anymore. Clarissa is devastated, she didn't even get to say goodbye!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: The InBESTigators
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E24 The Case Of The Copy Cat Ava is selected to deliver a speech at the town hall, but when she is accused of stealing it, Maudie must prove her innocence.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Shaun the Sheep
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S5 E17 Prickly heat It's a scorching hot day on the farm and the Flock need to cool off. When Bitzer discovers the Sheep Dip is out of action the Flock have to come up with another plan.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Odd Squad
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E109 Odds and Ends - Part 1 The agents must come together to battle a common enemy.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: ABC Kids Programs Resume At 4am
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: ABC Kids programs resume at 4.00am.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Teletubbies
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E60 Inside Outside The Teletubbies have lots of fun playing inside and outside Home Dome. They wave to the Tiddlytubbies from inside and outside too. In Tummy Tales, a girl helps her Dad take wet washing from inside to hang up outside to dry.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Disney Jr.'s Ariel
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E78 Razzle Dazzle / Fernie's Float Lucia's spell goes wrong. Fernie designs a float.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Daniel Tiger's Neighbourhood
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S7 E28 Miss Elaina Swims Miss Elaina swims across the pool without her pool noodle, doing it a little bit at a time.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Maddie + Triggs
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E24 Bloop Bloop There's something fishy about Maddie + Triggs' newest house guest, but they are determined to get to know the new arrival and really figure out what makes him bloop.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Ben & Holly's Little Kingdom
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E42 Nanny Plumb And The Wise Old Elf Swap Jobs For One Whole Day Nanny Plum believes she works harder than The Wise Old Elf. The Wise Old Elf believes he works harder than Nanny Plum! King Thistle commands them to swap jobs for the day to settle the argument.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Star Wars: Young Jedi Adventures
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E33 The Rainy Day Beast The Jedi look for a legendary creature within the temple.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: PJ Masks: Power Heroes
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E2 Heroes Everywhere Part Ii An Yu feels that something is up and joins Newton and the PJ Masks who are still looking for a way to keep the asteroid and its power of Badness away.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Octonauts: Above & Beyond
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E20 Nine-banded Armadillo In the aftermath of a fire in the Everglades, Ranger Marsh calls on Dashi & Tweak to help him figure out who stole a Florida box turtle's egg.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Thomas & Friends
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S26 E11 Brand New Track Thomas and Percy explore a brand-new track the evening before the route is opened and end up getting stuck in the mud overnight.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Numberblocks
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S5 E30 Space Division One Hundred assembles a Space Division to investigate a mysterious signal.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S7 E16 The Ambassadors of Death: Episode 5 The Doctor prepares to pilot the Recovery 7 ship into space, but Reegan sabotages the fuel supply which will send the Doctor into the sun.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S7 E17 The Ambassadors of Death: Episode 6 On board a vast spacecraft, the Doctor meets the alien captain who demands the return of the three ambassadors sent to Earth or he will destroy the world.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S7 E18 The Ambassadors of Death: Episode 7 General Carrington is behind the kidnapping of the ambassadors and intends to turn the world against the aliens by revealing their true identity to the world in a TV broadcast.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S7 E19 Inferno: Episode 1 UNIT are at a project run by Professor Stahlman who intends to penetrate Earth’s crust. But the drilling has already released something deadly from beneath the Earth’s surface.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S7 E20 Inferno: Episode 2 The green slime oozing from the drill head is transforming men into monsters. Stahlman refuses to listen to the warnings and resorts to sabotage so that his project may continue.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S7 E21 Inferno: Episode 3 Transported to a parallel world, the Doctor discovers that England is under military rule and the drilling project is at a more advanced stage.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S7 E22 Inferno: Episode 4 In the parallel world, the drilling project is about to penetrate the Earth’s crust. The Doctor, arrested as a spy, is unable to convince his captors of the danger that faces them.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S7 E23 Inferno: Episode 5 In the parallel world, Earth’s crust has been penetrated, releasing terrible forces from within the Earth. The Doctor must escape back to his world to prevent the same catastrophe.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S7 E24 Inferno: Episode 6 As the Earth in the parallel world faces destruction, the Doctor is desperate to return to his world to warn them of the danger. But time is running out.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S7 E25 Inferno: Episode 7 The Doctor has escaped the doomed, parallel Earth and has returned to his own world where he attempts to put a halt to the drilling project.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S8 E1 Terror of the Autons: Episode 1 The Master, a renegade Time Lord and a rival of the Doctor’s, arrives on Earth and paves the way for an invasion by the insidious Nestene Consciousness.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S8 E2 Terror of the Autons: Episode 2 The Doctor follows the Master’s trail to the circus. Meanwhile, the Master has used his hypnotic powers to take control of a plastics factory where he creates the deadly Autons.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S8 E3 Terror of the Autons: Episode 3 The Doctor and the Brigadier trace the Master to the plastics factory but they are too late. The only clue to the Master’s plans is a single plastic daffodil.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S8 E4 Terror of the Autons: Episode 4 The Doctor and UNIT race to prevent the Master from broadcasting the deadly activation signal and opening the channel for the Nestene’s arrival on Earth.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S1 E8 The Daleks: The Ambush Pretending to be a Dalek, Ian finds that that he is trapped inside the casing. The Doctor, Susan and Barbara have no choice but to abandon Ian as the real Daleks arrive and attack.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S1 E5 The Daleks: The Dead Planet The travellers venture out on to the surface of a new world. Everything is dead but beyond a petrified jungle they see a huge metal city which the Doctor is determined to explore.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S1 E7 The Daleks: The Escape Fearful of a Thal attack, the Daleks force Susan to trick the Thals. Realising that the Daleks are planning an ambush, the four travellers try to escape and warn the Thals.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S1 E9 The Daleks: The Expedition Ian and Barbara join a Thal expedition that will penetrate the Dalek city from the unguarded mountains behind it. Their journey is a dangerous one and not all will survive.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S1 E10 The Daleks: The Ordeal The Doctor and Susan are once again taken prisoner by the Daleks. In the mountains, Ian, Barbara and the Thals must negotiate a vast chasm to reach the city.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S1 E11 The Daleks: The Rescue The Thals and the time travellers attack the Daleks from all sides as the Daleks start the countdown to release deadly doses of radiation into the atmosphere.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S1 E6 The Daleks: The Survivors Looking for Barbara, the Doctor, Ian and Susan discover that they have exposed to lethal doses of radiation. The travellers are confronted by the city’s inhabitants – the Daleks!

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S1 E13 The Edge of Destruction: The Brink of Disaster As the power of the TARDIS threatens to escape and destroy the ship, the travellers become increasingly paranoid and hostile towards each other.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S1 E12 The Edge of Destruction: The Edge of Destruction The TARDIS is suspended in space and the Doctor, Ian, Barbara and Susan are confused and frightened by a series of inexplicable events.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S1 E25 The Keys of Marinus: Sentence of Death Arriving in the city of Millennius, Ian is put on trial for murder. The Doctor takes on the role of defence counsel and must prove Ian's innocence or he will be executed.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S1 E26 The Keys of Marinus: The Keys of Marinus The Doctor solves the murder mystery and finds the final missing key. With Ian now free, the travellers return to the island only to discover that Arbitan has been murdered.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S1 E23 The Keys of Marinus: The Screaming Jungle Ian and Barbara find a temple in the middle of a hostile jungle. Inside is the ailing Darrius, keeper of one of the keys. As Darrius dies he gives Ian a clue to find the key.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S1 E21 The Keys of Marinus: The Sea of Death The TARDIS lands on a remote island, surrounded by a sea of acid. They meet Arbitan, keeper of the Conscience of Marinus who forces the travellers to go in search of five keys.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S1 E24 The Keys of Marinus: The Snows of Terror In a snowy wasteland, Vasor, an unscrupulous trapper, imprisons the travellers in a frozen cavern inside a mountain. There they find one of the keys frozen in a block of ice.

ABCMESydney.au.title: 100% Wolf: Legend of the Moonstone
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E3 The Golden Horn Freddy attempts to teach Batty how to be human while searching for a cure for her new human form. A class assignment to capture the mysterious 'Golden Horn' and prove who the alpha wolf is goes awry when a wilderwolf attacks!

ABCMESydney.au.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo!
ABCMESydney.au.description: S2 E5 Worst In Show After a Giant Houndbeast attacks an elite dog show, the gang goes undercover and enters Scooby in the show in order to solve the mystery.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Summer Camp Island
ABCMESydney.au.description: S5 E3 Nightcap Barb and the elves band together to protect the source of all magic from a pair of fiendish intruders. But will Barb be able to outsmart two rascals as old as the world itself?

ABCMESydney.au.title: Total Drama Island: Reboot
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E2 Pirates of the Cabbagean Our two teams go to war, firing cabbages from cannons at each other from their respective pirate ships. The first team to sink the other will be the winner, but someone takes a very personal interest in one specific target.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Hotel Transylvania: The Series
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E18 Casket If You Can Mavis is tasked with guarding a sleeping Aunt Lydia in her rejuvenation casket. But naturally she loses the casket and it goes on a long adventure around town. Now Mavis needs to track it down and find it!

ABCMESydney.au.title: Submarine Jim
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E38 First Contact - Pt: 2 It's Jim's first day as captain, and the submarine is already hijacked by a mysterious sea creature. Thrown into his first high-stakes negotiation, does Jim have what it takes to lead?

ABCMESydney.au.title: The InBESTigators
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E22 The Case Of The Soccer Saga Kyle asks Maudie and Ava to make a video of his soccer match but Maudie discovers something about the game is not quite right.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Badjelly
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E6 Mouse Trap The gang are captured by Dinglemouse, a swashbuckling rodent who used to be a banana.

ABCMESydney.au.title: GG: Spawn Squad
ABCMESydney.au.description: S4 E30 Getting Home in Little Kitty Big City! Mila and Harry cause a little trouble in a big city as they attempt to get their kitty home! Along the way they help some ducklings, steal some fish and collect some quirky cat hats.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Unikitty
ABCMESydney.au.description: S2 E39 Trapped in the Tower During a fireworks show, Unikitty and Master Frown become trapped in the Unikitty Castle. She sees an opportunity to figure out why Master Frown is always such a Cranky McCrabby Face all the time.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Unikitty
ABCMESydney.au.description: S2 E40 Scary Tales 2 During the gang's Halloween party, Unikitty discovers Rick isn't scared of anything! They each tell their own ideas of what a spooky story is, hoping to scare the emotionless Rick for once.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Summer Camp Island
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E14 Moon Problems The Moon gets sad when Oscar loses his friendship bracelet.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Summer Camp Island
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E15 Monster Visit The monsters get nervous when their Godmonster comes for a visit.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Adventure Time
ABCMESydney.au.description: S2 E10 Go With Me Finn needs a date to the movies and must balance the contrasting advice of Jake and Marceline in wooing Princess Bubblegum so he can see that flick!

ABCMESydney.au.title: Pokémon Horizons: The Series
ABCMESydney.au.description: S3 E42 A Surprise Reunion The Rising Volt Tacklers are surprised by the arrival of some unexpected guests.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Pokémon Horizons: The Series
ABCMESydney.au.description: S3 E43 Lucario's Challenge! Roy and Lucario take on Master Mayonnaise and Mega Hawlucha in a rematch battle.

ABCMESydney.au.title: George Clarke's Amazing Spaces
ABCMESydney.au.description: S12 E1 Sky Cabin and a Viking Longhouse George has the ludicrous idea to turn a rusty scissor lift into a cabin in the sky! Four shipping containers become a one-off accommodation, and a trailer is turned into a pretty in pink beauty parlour.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Not Going Out
ABCMESydney.au.description: S12 E2 Painting It's been over a year since Frank's passing and unfortunately for Lee and Lucy, Wendy rediscovers her love of painting and gifts them a portrait of Frank. How can Lee and Lucy break the news that they don't like the likeness?

ABCMESydney.au.title: The Talented Mr. Ripley
ABCMESydney.au.description: In late 1950s New York, Tom Ripley, a young underachiever, is sent to Italy to retrieve Dickie Greenleaf, a rich and spoiled millionaire playboy. But when the errand fails, Ripley takes extreme measures.

ABCMESydney.au.title: ER
ABCMESydney.au.description: S4 E2 Something New Still suffering emotionally from his beating, Mark misdiagnoses cases. Carter deals with the loss of his seniority and meets his incompetent new medical student, George. Kenny Law's family sues for medical malpractice.

ABCMESydney.au.title: QI
ABCMESydney.au.description: S3 E10 Cleve Crudgington Joining Stephen Fry are Alan Davies, Mark Steel, Clive Anderson and John Sessions. The series continues with the 'C' theme.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Would I Lie To You?
ABCMESydney.au.description: S14 E12 The Best Bits Rob Brydon, Lee Mack and David Mitchell return in an episode packed with some of the best bits from the series. Guests include Richard Osman, Claudia Winkleman, Samantha Morton and AJ Odudu. (Final).

ABCMESydney.au.title: Mythbusters
ABCMESydney.au.description: S6 E5 Episode 5 It’s cops and swabbers as Adam and Jamie turn dirt detectives to get to the bottom of two frighteningly filthy myths, while Tory, Grant and Jessi skip the lake fantastic with a manic movie myth.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Phil Spencer: Secret Agent
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E18 Bristol Phil heads to the village of Hanham just near Bristol, where he meets owners who are eager to sell properties that include a three bedroom family home and a deceptively spacious terraced house.

ABCMESydney.au.title: George Clarke's Amazing Spaces
ABCMESydney.au.description: S12 E2 Seashell Bar and a Train Carriage A train carriage and a Luton Van get turned into accommodation, George Clarke visits an underground bar and a Danish house covered in seashells.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Spicks and Specks
ABCMESydney.au.description: S8 E25 Kasey Chambers, Brian Mannix, Claire Hooper & Rusty Berther The Spicks and Specks team are joined by one of Australia's favourite country singers Kasey Chambers, Uncanny X-Men front-man, rocker Brian Mannix and comedians Rusty Berther and Claire Hooper.

ABCMESydney.au.title: QI
ABCMESydney.au.description: S21 E2 \ Sandi Toksvig takes a look at animals that begin with the letter 'T' with Hannah Waddingham, Desiree Burch, Jason Manford, and Alan Davies.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Would I Lie To You?
ABCMESydney.au.description: S4 E1 Sanjeev Bhaskar, Fern Britton, Martin Clunes & Richard E. Grant Rob Brydon and team captains David Mitchell and Lee Mack are joined by Sanjeev Bhaskar, Fern Britton, Martin Clunes and Richard E. Grant.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Guy Montgomery's Guy Mont Spelling Bee (NZ)
ABCMESydney.au.description: S3 E8 Episode 8 Jackie van Beek, Jesse Griffin, Hoani Hotene and the Episode Seven champ battle to the spelling death in Spelling Carnival, Spell It Backwards and Spell the Audience Name.

ABCMESydney.au.title: triple j Live at the Wireless
ABCMESydney.au.description: S2 E3 Courtney Barnett triple j's legendary live music series, Live At The Wireless, is back with iconic performances. Iconic Australian singer-songwriter Courtney Barnett graces the stage, recorded live at the triple j 50 Tour in Hobart, Tasmania.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Upstart Crow
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E5 What Bloody Man Is That? The plague leads Will and his friends to escape to the family home in Stratford. On the way, they meet three witches who have some surprising predictions about Will's future, leading to a very serious case of house envy.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Upstart Crow
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E6 The Quality Of Mercy There's money to be made investing in cargos from the New World: but while Marlowe invests in tobacco and potato products, Will would rather invest in building a new theatre. (Final).

rage Charts
ABCMESydney.au.description: E326 Episode 326 Australia's longest running music TV show, rage is home to the biggest vault of music videos from a diverse range of artists, genres and eras. We curate the best clips of all time to surprise and entertain you for hours.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Not Going Out
ABCMESydney.au.description: S12 E3 Text When Lee mistakenly sends a rude text about Anna to Lucy, he makes the stupid mistake of sending it to Anna herself. Lee and Lucy now face the onerous task of stealing Anna's phone and deleting the text before she reads it.

ABCMESydney.au.title: QI
ABCMESydney.au.description: S18 E10 Rest And Recreation Sandi Toksvig indulges in a bit of well-earned R&R alongside Alan Davies, Stephen K Amos, Susan Calman and Lou Sanders.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Phil Spencer: Secret Agent
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E19 Swansea Phil is in the coastal city of Swansea, giving advice to owners who want to sell properties which include a four bedroom end of terrace house and a four bedroom Edwardian property.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Breeders
ABCMESydney.au.description: S4 E7 No Kids Paul and Ally are disappointed that their family holiday becomes just the two of them, but they soon make new friends. Luke is preparing for his new life with Maya and makes a decision which leaves them both terrified.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Breeders
ABCMESydney.au.description: S4 E8 No Control Paul and Ally rush to fly back from their holiday when they hear that Maya is giving birth five weeks early. Ava and Sunil try to help Luke step up and become a father, but everyone is in shock when complications set in.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Breeders
ABCMESydney.au.description: S4 E9 No Matter What: Part 1 As Paul and Ally try to help Luke, struggling with being a dad and a student, they find they have very different ideas about the best way forward. Jackie's condition becomes more noticeable, and Jim is determined to help out.

ABCMESydney.au.title: ABC News Update
ABCMESydney.au.description: E94 Monday 23 November 2026 The headlines from ABC News, updating you on the day's top stories from across Australia and around the world.

ABCMESydney.au.title: QI
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E10 Aviation The panellists in this episode are willing and able to make a noise, and they are: Alan Davies, Australia's Julia Morris, Rich Hall and Peter Serafinowicz.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Adventure Time
ABCMESydney.au.description: S2 E18 Susan Strong Finn and Jake meet some humans living underground. Except, they find the Candy People irresistible.

ABCMESydney.au.title: We Baby Bears
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E29 A Real Crayon The Bears find a mysterious crayon that has the power to make anything they draw become REAL.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Teen Titans Go!
ABCMESydney.au.description: S5 E49 Girls Night In Part 1 The Girls Night Out crew decide to stay in and have a slumber party, but an unknown alien threat descends on Jump City.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Malory Towers
ABCMESydney.au.description: S4 E1 The Ghost Of Christmas Present (part 1) It's Christmas Eve and the last day of term at Malory Towers. Everyone is excited! Darrell is disappointed that her parents have been delayed due to bad weather and that she'll have to stay at school for Christmas.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Total Dramarama
ABCMESydney.au.description: S3 E35 The Three Stooges Save Christmas Pt. 1 The kids accidentally destroy Chef's decorated Christmas tree. Scared this means they've ruined his Christmas, they go on an epic mission to replace his holiday treasures.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Unikitty
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E1 Spoooooky Game In this Halloween episode, the gang’s weekly board game night has been getting a little too competitive lately, so when Unikitty finds a spooky old board game that’s clearly haunted, their desire to win gets turned on its head.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Summer Camp Island
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E1 The First Day Best friends Oscar and Hedgehog get dropped off at their first day at summer camp.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Gangnam Project
ABCMESydney.au.description: S2 E1 New Order Ken's out and Sandra is officially in charge of OME. If RADI8 wants to debut, they'll have to prove to her that they've got what it takes to shine.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Pokemon: Ruby and Sapphire
ABCMESydney.au.description: S6 E36 The Spheal of Approval A day of relaxation in Slateport City turns into a confrontation between Team Rocket and Team Magma!

ABCMESydney.au.title: Transformers: Earthspark
ABCMESydney.au.description: S2 E10 Dude, Where's My Trailer? Optimus lands a prestigious photoshoot, so Robby and Hashtag take his battle worn trailer to get detailed. Unfortunately, the Decepticons steal it from them! The kids race the clock to get it back in one piece.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Miraculous: Tales Of Ladybug And Cat Noir
ABCMESydney.au.description: S6 E1 Climatiqueen Ladybug and Cat Noir face a villain determined to steal their thunder; will the superheroes weather the storm?

kwkt.us.title: Below Deck
kwkt.us.description: This reality series profiles a group of young people who work aboard yachts that measure well over 100 feet long. The crew members, known as yachties, live aboard the luxurious, privately owned vessels while making sure that their demanding clients' ever-changing needs are met. The yachties share a passion for a job that allows them to visit some of the world's most beautiful places. Each episode features a different group of passengers -- ranging from millionaires to hard-partying friends -- as they head out for a marine adventure. ktxa.us.title: Zoo Clues
ktxa.us.description: With all of the various animal species roaming around the planet there's a lot to know about animals, which means no one knows everything about them. Have you ever wondered if birds can fly backward, how animals without external ears hear, or why zebras have stripes? Those are among the questions waiting for answers on "Zoo Clues." While there, they reflect on their first decade of marriage -- memories of when they first met, of courtship and of road trips through the French countryside. As flirtation and playful quarreling turn to boredom with the banality of married life, the Wallaces struggle to rekindle their passion, while mutual infidelity threatens to tear them apart. (movie) - 1967

fxm.us.title: Gentlemen Prefer Blondes
fxm.us.description: Lorelei Lee (Marilyn Monroe) is a beautiful showgirl engaged to be married to the wealthy Gus Esmond (Tommy Noonan), much to the disapproval of Gus' rich father, Esmond Sr., who thinks that Lorelei is just after his money. When Lorelei goes on a cruise accompanied only by her best friend, Dorothy Shaw (Jane Russell), Esmond Sr. hires Ernie Malone (Elliott Reid), a private detective, to follow her and report any questionable behavior that would disqualify her from the marriage. (movie) - 1953

fxm.us.title: How to Be Very, Very Popular
fxm.us.description: A showgirl from the San Francisco cabaret is murdered, and the only witnesses are fellow showgirls Stormy Tornado (Betty Grable) and Curly Flagg (Sheree North). Afraid of both the murderers and the cops, the two go on the run, eventually deciding to pose as male students at Bristol College. Neither girl can avoid the spotlight for too long, though, and their constant desire to stand out among the crowd eventually gets the better of them, resulting in their cover being blown. (movie) - 1955

fxm.us.title: 9 to 5
fxm.us.description: Office satire about three female secretaries who decide to get revenge on their tyrannical, sexist boss by abducting him and running the business themselves. The trio, one of whom has been passed over for promotion because she is a woman, spend a night together having drug-induced fantasies of killing the slave-driving chauvinist. One of them panics the following day when she suspects she really has poisoned the tyrant. (movie) - 1980

fxm.us.title: Working Girl
fxm.us.description: Savvy New York City receptionist Tess McGill (Melanie Griffith) gives her conniving boss, Katharine Parker (Sigourney Weaver), an excellent business tip, but Katharine simply steals the idea without giving due credit to her secretary. After Katharine winds up in the hospital with an injured leg, Tess decides to exact revenge. Pretending to be her boss, Tess initiates a major deal with an investment broker (Harrison Ford) -- but things turn ugly after Katharine finds out what Tess has been up to. (movie) - 1988

fxm.us.title: Moulin Rouge
fxm.us.description: A celebration of love and creative inspiration takes place in the infamous, gaudy and glamorous Parisian nightclub, at the cusp of the 20th century. A young poet (Ewan McGregor), who is plunged into the heady world of Moulin Rouge, begins a passionate affair with the club's most notorious and beautiful star (Nicole Kidman). (movie) - 2001

fxm.us.title: Long Weekend
fxm.us.description: An enchanted weekend courtship leads to unexpected revelations between a young man and woman who harbor deep secrets. (movie) - 2021

fxm.us.title: The Broken Hearts Gallery
fxm.us.description: Dumped by her boyfriend, a New York art gallery assistant creates an exhibit for souvenirs from past relationships. (movie) - 2020

fxm.us.title: This Means War
fxm.us.description: CIA operatives FDR Foster (Chris Pine) and Tuck (Tom Hardy) are inseparable best friends and partners. Together, their good looks, covert abilities and combat skills rank them among the CIA's elite, but their longstanding personal and professional bond is put to the test when they meet Lauren (Reese Witherspoon). FDR and Tuck both fall hard for the beautiful blonde, turning their deadly skills and an array of high-tech gadgetry against each other in an all-out battle for her love. (movie) - 2012

fxm.us.title: The Heat
fxm.us.description: FBI Special Agent Sarah Ashburn (Sandra Bullock) is a methodical investigator with a long-standing reputation for excellence -- and arrogance. In contrast, foul-mouthed, hot-tempered detective Shannon Mullins (Melissa McCarthy) goes with her gut instincts and street smarts to remove criminals from the streets of Boston. Sparks fly when these polar opposites have to work together to capture a drug lord, but in the process, they become the last thing anyone expected -- buddies. (movie) - 2013

fxm.us.title: You Again
fxm.us.description: Marni is shocked to learn that her brother is marrying her school bully from the past. When she tries to expose her, things do not go as planned. (movie) - 2010

fxm.us.title: Long Weekend
fxm.us.description: An enchanted weekend courtship leads to unexpected revelations between a young man and woman who harbor deep secrets. (movie) - 2021

fxm.us.title: The Egyptian
fxm.us.description: In ancient Egypt, Sinuhe (Edmund Purdom) is a would-be doctor who saves the life of a young man (Michael Wilding) suffering from a seizure. When the afflicted youth awakes, he introduces himself as the Pharaoh Akhnaton and makes Sinuhe the royal healer. While working at his new, prestigious post, Sinuhe suffers through a botched romance and the death of his adoptive parents. Despondent, he leaves the Pharaoh's court to bury his loved ones, and, in the process, incurs the wrath of Akhnaton. (movie) - 1954

fxm.us.title: Wizards
fxm.us.description: After the death of his mother, the evil mutant wizard Blackwolf (Steve Gravers) discovers some long-lost military technologies. Full of ego and ambition, Blackwolf claims his mother's throne, assembles an army and sets out to brainwash and conquer Earth. Meanwhile, Blackwolf's gentle twin brother, the bearded and sage Avatar (Bob Holt), calls upon his own magical abilities to foil Blackwolf's plans for world domination -- even if it means destroying his own flesh and blood. (movie) - 1977

fxm.us.title: The Adventures of Hajji Baba
fxm.us.description: A clever Persian barber (John Derek) wows the harem and wins a princess (Elaine Stewart) by saving her from an evil prince. (movie) - 1954

documentary+.us.description: While people may think they know what nurses do, "Nurse: Empathy Heals" reveals what nurses face daily when caring for their patients: personal stories that reveal moments of doubt, faith, grief, joy and fierce love.

documentary+.us.title: Lisa Dahl: Blessed by Grace
documentary+.us.description: The journey of Lisa Dahl, who turned personal tragedy into a culinary career.

documentary+.us.title: Hi I'm Blake
documentary+.us.description: After a gymnastics accident leaves him severely brain-damaged, Blake Hyland creates a platform to bring awareness and hope to everyone he meets on the road to recovery while his family wrestles to restore him to his former self.

documentary+.us.title: Dancing Warrior
documentary+.us.description: On Pine Ridge Reservation, Lakota teens find hope racing horses in Indian Relay.

documentary+.us.title: Talking Drum
documentary+.us.description: Explore the healing power of drumming through community leaders using the universal language of rhythm.

documentary+.us.title: A Swim Lesson
documentary+.us.description: An ode to an everyday hero: Bill Marsh, a swim teacher who helps children manage their fears.

documentary+.us.title: NFX
documentary+.us.description: Neurofibromatosis affects individuals with a genetic disease that causes tumors. These are their stories.

documentary+.us.title: The Blessings Of Aging
documentary+.us.description: The sweet and sassy residents of a retirement community explain the many upsides of getting older.

documentary+.us.title: After Skid Row
documentary+.us.description: For over a decade, Barbie Carter was among the thousands on individuals living on Skid Row, Los Angeles. After being approved for housing, she forges a bond with an aid worker, and together they work to keep her off the streets.

documentary+.us.title: Pickle Man
documentary+.us.description: When faced with certain death by ALS, photographer-turned-local legend Arthur Cohen decides to leave a legacy of pickles -- PickALS, that is.

documentary+.us.title: VOYAGEURS - Chapter One
documentary+.us.description: Ultra Runner Courtney Haile makes a fierce bid to crush her personal best at the Javelina Jundred.

documentary+.us.title: Breakaway: The Refugee World Cup
documentary+.us.description: Two refugees rediscover hope, community, and identity through the unifying power of soccer.

documentary+.us.title: The Decathletes
documentary+.us.description: Granada Hills Charter High School in Los Angeles sets out to cement their legacy in the academic decathlon.

documentary+.us.title: The Last Stand
documentary+.us.description: A documentary on the urgent fight to save the world's ancient forests.

documentary+.us.title: The Final 19
documentary+.us.description: The story of Sgt. Daniel Hefel, who was one of the final 19 Prisoners of War (POWs) to come home from Vietnam.

365blk.us.title: Judge Mathis
365blk.us.description: A man sues his ex-girlfriend because, he says, after they broke up, she set everything he owned on fire. (Reality, Law) - 2020-04-03

365blk.us.title: In the Heat of the Night - Dangerous Engagement
365blk.us.description: Harriet and Bill become targets of a crazed gunman on the eve of their wedding; guest William Gannon. (Crime drama, Mystery) - 1994-05-04

365blk.us.title: In the Heat of the Night - Give Me Your Life
365blk.us.description: As Bill and Harriet prepare for their honeymoon, a cult leader's (Peter Fonda) activities get the attention of Forbes. (Crime drama, Mystery) - 1994-05-11

365blk.us.title: In the Heat of the Night - A Matter of Justice (Pt. 1 & 2)
365blk.us.description: The trail of a serial killer leads the sheriff and police chief to a prominent citizen in Sparta, Miss. (Crime drama, Mystery) - 1994-10-21

365blk.us.title: War
365blk.us.description: After his partner and family are killed, FBI agent Jack Crawford (Jason Statham) becomes obsessed with revenge on an assassin named Rogue (Jet Li). Rogue's return sparks a violent war between rival Asian mobsters Chang (John Lone) and Shiro (Ryo Ishibashi), while the ultimate showdown between Crawford and Rogue reveals the truth. (movie) - 2007

365blk.us.title: Ricochet
365blk.us.description: After tracking down and arresting Earl Talbot Blake (John Lithgow), a psychotic hit man, rookie Los Angeles police officer Nick Styles (Denzel Washington) is hailed as a hero. Several years later, Styles' life appears perfect: He has married his girlfriend, started a family and risen to the position of assistant district attorney. However, his world is turned upside down when Blake escapes from prison with plans to exact brutal and well-calculated revenge. (movie) - 1991

365blk.us.title: Shaft's Big Score!
365blk.us.description: Private detective John Shaft runs afoul of feuding mobsters as he searches for the truth behind a friend's death. (movie) - 1972

365blk.us.title: Shaft in Africa
365blk.us.description: When private investigator and man of action John Shaft is hired to disrupt a slavery ring, he must travel to Africa and infiltrate the criminal operation. While undercover, Shaft discovers that Africans are being abducted and sold as slaves in Europe, with a sinister figure named Amafi pulling the strings. As Shaft gets closer to taking down Amafi, his situation becomes increasingly dangerous, with assassins and thugs seemingly lurking around every corner. (movie) - 1973

365blk.us.title: Queen Sugar - By Any Chance
365blk.us.description: Nova's romantic relationship with Calvin, a local cop, becomes strained in her pursuit of justice; Charley faces her husband's accuser; Aunt Violet receives unwelcome feedback at work. (Drama) - 2016-09-28

365blk.us.title: Queen Sugar - As Promised
365blk.us.description: Nova's public comments about Charley's marriage causes a rift between the two; Ralph Angel tries to get out of an illegal arrangement; Charley learns what Davis did during the night in question. (Drama) - 2016-10-05

365blk.us.title: Snitch
365blk.us.description: At 18 years old, Jason receives a mandatory 10-year prison sentence after being caught with a package that contained illegal drugs, although he was unaware of its contents. His father, businessman John Matthews (Dwayne Johnson), is devastated. When Jason turns down a chance to lessen his sentence by manufacturing evidence to implicate someone else, John begs to be sent undercover instead, but the already dangerous venture turns deadly after he exposes a major player in the Mexican drug trade. (movie) - 2013

365blk.us.title: Boiling Point
365blk.us.description: A Treasury agent (Wesley Snipes) and a mobster (Dennis Hopper) hunt each other according to their separate-but-equal deadlines for success. (movie) - 1993

365blk.us.title: Murder at 1600
365blk.us.description: A secretary is found dead in a White House bathroom during an international crisis, and Detective Harlan Regis is in charge of the investigation. Despite resistance from the Secret Service, Regis partners with agent Nina Chance. As political tensions rise, they learn that the crime could be part of an elaborate cover-up. Framed as traitors, the pair and Regis' partner break into the White House to expose the true culprit. (movie) - 1997

365blk.us.title: Alex Cross
365blk.us.description: Alex Cross (Tyler Perry) works as a detective/psychologist for the Detroit Police Department along with his lifelong friend, Tommy Kane (Edward Burns), and detective Monica Ashe (Rachel Nichols). Cross' latest case puts him on a collision course with Picasso (Matthew Fox), a cunning serial killer whose ultimate target is multinational industrialist Giles Mercier (Jean Reno). Cross must find a way inside Picasso's head not only to catch the killer but also to stem the violent urges Cross feels. (movie) - 2012

365blk.us.title: Tyler Perry's Temptation: Confessions of a Marriage Counselor
365blk.us.description: Judith (Jurnee Smollett-Bell) has known her husband, Brice (Lance Gross), since they were in high school, but now their marriage is growing stale. Having just completed her graduate work in psychotherapy, she's eager to begin a career as a marriage counselor. She takes an internship at a matchmaking firm for millionaires and meets Harley (Robbie Jones), a charismatic client who makes no effort to hide his attraction to Judith. Judith succumbs to his charms, placing her marriage in jeopardy. (movie) - 2013

365blk.us.title: Hurricane Season
365blk.us.description: One year after the devastation of Hurricane Katrina, high-school basketball coach Al Collins (Forest Whitaker) gathers displaced students and rebuilds the school team, the Patriots. Though the young athletes originally hailed from five different schools, Collins builds them into a cohesive unit and takes aim at the high-school basketball championship. (movie) - 2009

365blk.us.title: Passing Glory
365blk.us.description: When Joseph Verrett (Andre Braugher), a Jesuit priest who teaches history at a black high school, is offered the position of basketball coach, he resists at first because he believes the school glorifies sports over education. Eventually, though, Joseph accepts and sets up a game with the unbeaten team from the white Jesuit high school. Father Grant (Rip Torn), the pastor of the parish, cautions against such a divisive move, but Joseph disagrees and prepares his team for the game. (movie) - 1999

365blk.us.title: Uncle Drew
365blk.us.description: After draining his life savings to enter a team in the Rucker Classic street ball tournament in Harlem, Dax is dealt a series of setbacks, including losing his team to his longtime rival. Desperate to win the tournament and the cash prize, Dax stumbles upon the man, the myth, the legend Uncle Drew and convinces him to return to the court one more time. The two men embark on a road trip to round up Drew's old basketball squad and prove that a group of septuagenarians can still win the big one. (movie) - 2018

365blk.us.title: Collateral Beauty
365blk.us.description: When a successful New York advertising executive (Will Smith) suffers a great tragedy, he retreats from life. While his concerned friends try desperately to reconnect with him, he seeks answers from the universe by writing letters to Love, Time and Death. When his notes bring unexpected personal responses, he begins to understand how these constants interlock in a life fully lived and how even the deepest loss can reveal moments of meaning and beauty. (movie) - 2016

365blk.us.title: B.A.P.S
365blk.us.description: Waitresses at a Georgia restaurant, Nisi and Mickey, decide to fly to Los Angeles for a music-video audition in order to raise money for their dream project, a business that combines soul-food dining with a hair salon. Circumstances eventually find the Southern ladies on the estate of Mr. Blakemore, an elderly millionaire. Despite their vast cultural differences, Nisi and Mickey form close bonds with Blakemore and his butler. (movie) - 1997

365blk.us.title: Showtime
365blk.us.description: When a no-nonsense LAPD detective (Robert De Niro) is forced to star in a reality-based television show with a frustrated actor-turned-LAPD-patrolman (Eddie Murphy), they find their lives turned upside down by a powerhouse producer (Rene Russo) and her very intrusive camera crew. (movie) - 2002

5starmax.us.title: Head Office
5starmax.us.description: A U.S. senator's son (Judge Reinhold) gets a job at a conglomerate and falls for the chairman's (Eddie Albert) radical daughter. (Comedy) - 1986

5starmax.us.title: Walkabout
5starmax.us.description: Under the pretense of having a picnic, a geologist (John Meillon) takes his teenage daughter (Jenny Agutter) and 6-year-old son (Lucien John) into the Australian outback and attempts to shoot them. When he fails, he turns the gun on himself, and the two city-bred children must contend with harsh wilderness alone. They are saved by a chance encounter with an Aboriginal boy (David Gulpilil) who shows them how to survive and in the process underscores the disharmony between nature and modern life. (Adventure) - 1971

5starmax.us.title: Scream
5starmax.us.description: The sleepy little town of Woodsboro just woke up screaming. There's a killer in their midst who's seen a few too many scary movies. Suddenly nobody is safe, as the psychopath stalks victims, taunts them with trivia questions, then rips them to bloody shreds. It could be anybody. (Horror, Comedy) - 1996

5starmax.us.title: Dim Sum Funeral
5starmax.us.description: In the wake of her death, the embittered children of Chinese-American matriarch Mrs. Xiao (Lisa Lu) begrudgingly return to their childhood home for a bristly -- and brief, they hope -- reunion. But after Xiao's maid and sole confidant, Viola (Talia Shire), reveals her wish to undergo a week-long Buddhist funeral rite, the younger Xiaos -- including plastic surgeon Alexander (Russell Wong) and lesbian actress Meimei (Steph Song) -- have seven days to come to terms with her death, and each other. (Comedy drama) - 2008

5starmax.us.title: The Last Emperor
5starmax.us.description: This sweeping account of the life of Pu Yi (John Lone), the last emperor of China, follows the leader's tumultuous reign. After being captured by the Red Army as a war criminal in 1950, Pu Yi recalls his childhood from prison. He remembers his lavish youth in the Forbidden City, where he was afforded every luxury but unfortunately sheltered from the outside world and complex political situation surrounding him. As revolution sweeps through China, the world Pu Yi knew is dramatically upended. (Biography, Historical drama) - 1987

5starmax.us.title: A History of Violence
5starmax.us.description: When a pair of petty criminals attempt to rob his small-town diner, Tom Stall (Viggo Mortensen) quickly and easily kills them both. In the flush of news coverage of Tom's seemingly heroic actions, a threatening stranger named Carl Fogarty (Ed Harris) comes to town, fingering the unassuming family man as long-missing Philadelphia mobster Joey Cusack. To the horror of his wife, Edie (Maria Bello), and teenage son, Jack (Ashton Holmes), Tom finds he must confront his violent past. (Drama, Thriller) - 2005

5starmax.us.title: The Usual Suspects
5starmax.us.description: "The greatest trick the devil ever pulled was convincing the world he didn't exist," says con man Kint, drawing a comparison to the most enigmatic criminal of all time, Keyser Söze. Kint attempts to convince the feds that the mythic crime lord not only exists, but is also responsible for drawing Kint and his four partners into a multi-million dollar heist that ended with an explosion in San Pedro Harbor - leaving few survivors. (Thriller, Crime drama) - 1995

5starmax.us.title: Mothra vs. Godzilla
5starmax.us.description: Japan comes under attack from two monsters in a giant monster battle between a rampaging Godzilla and the colossal genetically engineered moth called Mothra. (Science fiction) - 1964

5starmax.us.title: Rodan
5starmax.us.description: A bug-eating pterodactyl flies out of a coal mine and wrecks Japan with sonic booms. (Science fiction) - 1957

5starmax.us.title: Hop
5starmax.us.description: Beneath Easter Island, in a giant factory that manufactures the world's Easter candy, the popular rabbit is preparing to pass the mantle to his son, E.B. (Russell Brand). But E.B. has no interest in the job and would rather be a drummer. He runs away to Los Angeles, where an unemployed slacker named Fred O'Hare (James Marsden) accidentally runs into him. Feigning injury, E.B. tricks Fred into giving him shelter, but an oversized chick is planning a coup back on Easter Island. (Family, Holiday, Comedy, Animated) - 2011

5starmax.us.title: Flashpoint
5starmax.us.description: Texas border patrolmen (Kris Kristofferson, Treat Williams) find a jeep, a skeleton and $800,000 in cash dating from 1963. (Action) - 1984

5starmax.us.title: For All Mankind
5starmax.us.description: Directed by Al Reinert and with music scored by Brian Eno, "For All Mankind" provides a testament to NASA's Apollo program of the 1960s and '70s. Composed of actual NASA footage of the missions and astronaut interviews, the documentary offers the viewpoint of the individuals who braved the remarkable journey to the moon and back. While compiling the material for the film, Reinert went through more than six million feet of film of these historic moments. (Documentary) - 1989

5starmax.us.title: It's Kind of a Funny Story
5starmax.us.description: Stressed by adolescence, 16-year-old Craig Gilner (Keir Gilchrist) checks himself into a mental-health clinic. Unfortunately, the youth wing is closed, so he must spend his mandated five-day stay with adults. One of them, Bobby (Zach Galifianakis), quickly becomes his mentor -- and protégé, while Craig finds himself drawn to a fellow teen, Noelle (Emma Roberts), who just may be the cure he needs to forget an unrequited crush. (Comedy drama) - 2010

5starmax.us.title: Holla
5starmax.us.description: A mysterious killer stalks a sitcom actress (Shelli Boone) and her companions (Young Sir, Michael Bergin) on a weekend getaway in the wilderness. (Horror) - 2006

5starmax.us.title: Odd Jobs
5starmax.us.description: The summer job situation looks bleak for five college pals until they decide to start their own moving business. (Comedy) - 1986

5starmax.us.title: Repo Men
5starmax.us.description: In the future, medical technology has advanced to the point where people can buy artificial organs to extend their lives. But if they default on payments, an organization known as the Union sends agents to repossess the organs. Remy (Jude Law) is one of the best agents in the business, but when he becomes the recipient of an artificial heart, he finds himself in the same dire straits as his many victims. With his former partner (Forest Whitaker) in hot pursuit, Remy runs for his life. (Science fiction, Action, Thriller) - 2010

5starmax.us.title: Wedding Crashers
5starmax.us.description: Jeremy (Vince Vaughn) and John (Owen Wilson) are divorce mediators who spend their free time crashing wedding receptions. For the irrepressible duo, there are few better ways to drink for free and bed vulnerable women. So when Secretary of the Treasury William Cleary (Christopher Walken) announces the wedding of his daughter, the pair make it their mission to crash the high-profile event. But their game hits a bump in the road when John locks eyes with bridesmaid Claire (Rachel McAdams). (Romantic comedy) - 2005

5starmax.us.title: X-Men: First Class
5starmax.us.description: In the early 1960s, during the height of the Cold War, a mutant named Charles Xavier (James McAvoy) meets a fellow mutant named Erik Lehnsherr (Michael Fassbender). Despite their vastly different backgrounds -- Charles grew up with a wealthy family, while Erik lost his parents at Auschwitz -- the two become close friends. As the world teeters on the brink of a nuclear war, Charles and Erik with other mutants join forces to save humanity. However, a situation soon tears the friends apart. (Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Science fiction) - 2011

5starmax.us.title: Lord of the Flies
5starmax.us.description: Amidst a nuclear war, a plane carrying a group of schoolboys crash lands on a deserted island. With no adult survivors, the boys are forced to fend for themselves. At first, they cooperate, but when they split into two separate camps -- one led by the pragmatic Ralph (James Aubrey) and the other by militaristic Jack (Tom Chapin) -- their society falls into disarray, leading to a disturbing examination of human nature and a chilling conclusion. (Drama, Adventure, Thriller) - 1963

5starmax.us.title: Rise of the Planet of the Apes
5starmax.us.description: Will Rodman, a scientist in San Francisco, is experimenting with a drug that he hopes will cure his father's Alzheimer's disease. After his work is deemed a failure, Will becomes the guardian of Caesar, an infant chimp who was exposed in utero to Will's drug. Caesar displays unusual intelligence, and Will decides to continue his experiments secretly. But as Caesar's intellect and abilities grow, he comes to represent a threat to man's dominion over Earth. (Science fiction, Action, Adventure) - 2011

5starmax.us.title: Time Bandits
5starmax.us.description: Young history buff Kevin (Craig Warnock) can scarcely believe it when six dwarfs emerge from his closet one night. Former employees of the Supreme Being (Ralph Richardson), they've purloined a map charting all the holes in the fabric of time and are using it to steal treasures from different historical eras. Taking Kevin with them, they variously drop in on Napoleon (Ian Holm), Robin Hood (John Cleese) and King Agamemnon (Sean Connery) before the Supreme Being catches up with them. (Fantasy) - 1981

5starmax.us.title: The Blair Witch Project
5starmax.us.description: Found video footage tells the tale of three film students (Heather Donahue, Joshua Leonard, Michael C. Williams) who've traveled to a small town to collect documentary footage about the Blair Witch, a legendary local murderer. Over the course of several days, the students interview townspeople and gather clues to support the tale's veracity. But the project takes a frightening turn when the students lose their way in the woods and begin hearing horrific noises. (Horror, Thriller) - 1999

5starmax.us.title: Book of Shadows: Blair Witch 2
5starmax.us.description: As it follows the twisted path traveled by five people fixated on "The Blair Witch Project," "Book of Shadows: Blair Witch 2" journeys into a dark and dangerous place where the line between truth and fiction blurs and perhaps vanishes altogether. Individual perception grows increasingly untrustworthy as the film's protagonists find themselves caught in a vortex of unspeakable evil, the origins of which -- human or supernatural -- remain chillingly uncertain. (Adventure, Fantasy, Horror) - 2000

5starmax.us.title: Enter Nowhere
5starmax.us.description: Three strangers arrive one at a time in a remote cabin, and learn they have been brought together for a reason. (Drama, Horror, Mystery, Thriller) - 2011

5starmax.us.title: Despicable Me
5starmax.us.description: Supervillain Gru, a man who delights in all things wicked, hatches a plan to steal the moon. Surrounded by an army of little yellow minions and his impenetrable arsenal of weapons and war machines, Gru prepares to vanquish all who stand in his way. However, nothing in his calculations and groundwork has prepared him for his greatest challenge: three adorable orphan girls who want to make him their dad. (Animated, Children, Comedy, Adventure) - 2010

5starmax.us.title: The Daytrippers
5starmax.us.description: Eliza D'Amico's seemingly idyllic marriage to Louis changes dramatically when she discovers what she believes to be a love letter to him from someone else. Going home to her family for comfort, Eliza sets out with her mother, father, sister and her sister's boyfriend in the family car to track down and confront Louis. Always one step behind him, the family learns a lot about each other in the process. (Comedy) - 1996

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's India

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's India

bbcfood.us.title: Nigellissima
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E03 Episode 3 Pork loin stuffed with Parma ham and oregano, served alongside her speedy mock mash and lazy person's vignarola.

bbcfood.us.title: Nigellissima
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E05 Nigella starts with her take on a light and sunny yogurt pot cake; she recruits her niece and nephew to make a shortcut sausage meatball supper; Nigella prepares squid and prawns with marjoram and chili; a tiramisu ends the evening.

bbcfood.us.title: Nigellissima
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E06 Episode 6 Lamb chops with mint; chilli and golden potatoes; ruby red plum and amoretti crumble; farro risotto with mushrooms.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Far Eastern Odyssey

bbcfood.us.title: Ainsley's Barbecue Bible
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E02 Greece Visiting the Greek Island of Alonnisos to sample traditional barbecue consisting of spit-roasted lamb and hortopita.

bbcfood.us.title: Ainsley's Barbecue Bible
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E03 South Africa Visiting South Africa to find unusual recipes for cooking over coals.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Mediterranean Escapes

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Mediterranean Escapes
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E03 Sicily and Puglia Rick travels from Sicily to Puglia.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Mediterranean Escapes
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E04 Corfu Rick departs Italy and makes his way to the Greek island of Corfu, where he attends a family feast; he visits kitchens in restaurants all over the island and learns how to make dishes such as a Greek peasant salad with feta and olives and more.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Mediterranean Escapes
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E05 Mallorca and Catalonia In Mallorca, Rick finds wonderful seafood dishes and the most succulent roast lamb he's ever tasted, while in Barcelona he samples Catalonian food at the famous Boqueria market.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Mediterranean Escapes

bbcfood.us.title: Rachel Khoo's Kitchen Notebook: London

bbcfood.us.title: Rachel Khoo's Kitchen Notebook: London
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E02 Crowd Pleasers Rachel makes some simple colorful canapés that are perfect for a party and creates a sophisticated jelly for grown-ups.

bbcfood.us.title: Rachel Khoo's Kitchen Notebook: London
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E03 Nostalgia London makes Rachel feel nostalgic about her childhood, so she visits an ice-cream lab in North London and makes a firm family favorite - Strudel.

bbcfood.us.title: Rachel Khoo's Kitchen Notebook: London
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E04 Fast Food Rachel explores London's fast food scene, and whips up berry tartlets with cream cheese frosting and cauliflower cheeseburgers.

bbcfood.us.title: Rachel Khoo's Kitchen Notebook: London
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E05 Lazy Days Rachel prepares her favourite food for the perfect lazy day, cycles along a canal, visits her friend Tom's urban garden, and whips up a shepherdless pie.

bbcfood.us.title: Rachel Khoo's Kitchen Notebook: London
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E06 East Meets West Rachel celebrates London's love with the East as she makes sticky chicken with Malaysian salad and soft steamed buns.

bbcfood.us.title: Rachel Khoo's Kitchen Notebook: London
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E07 Traditional Values Rachel celebrates Londoners' love of tradition as she puts her own twist on the traditional fry-up and makes a simple one-tray roast.

bbcfood.us.title: Rachel Khoo's Kitchen Notebook: London
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E08 On The Move Rachel joins an unusual supper club on an old tube carriage and makes sausage and mash for taxi drivers.

bbcfood.us.title: Rachel Khoo's Kitchen Notebook: London
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E09 DIY Rachel visits a basement Norwegian style salmon smokehouse and a shop where the shelves are stocked with preserves made on a hob at home.

bbcfood.us.title: Rachel Khoo's Kitchen Notebook: London
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E10 The Pleasure's All Mine Rachel goes for a decadent champagne afternoon tea in Mayfair and makes some finger-licking ribs.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Long Weekends

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Long Weekends

buzzr.us.title: The Price Is Right
buzzr.us.description: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." That's repeated in the second half of the show, and two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. Models present the prizes. (Game show) - 1972-09-04

buzzr.us.title: Card Sharks
buzzr.us.description: This show from legendary Mark Goodson-Bill Todman Productions features two contestants trying to predict answers to survey questions for the opportunity to play a game with oversized playing cards for a chance to win cash. One contestant guesses how many people (out of 100) gave a certain answer to a question and the other contestant then guesses if the number is higher or lower than the opponent's guess. The winning contestant then faces a row of cards and must determine if each succeeding card is higher or lower than the one that precedes it. The contestant who wins two out of three games wins the match and plays the bonus round, called Money Cards. The Money Cards round is similar to the card game in the main game but with three levels of cards instead of one row. The contestant is given $200 at the beginning of Money Cards and wagers any or all of that money when guessing if the cards will be higher or lower than the previous one. A perfect round could earn the contestant $28,800. (Game show) - 1978-04-24
