buzzr.us.title: The Price Is Right
buzzr.us.description: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." That's repeated in the second half of the show, and two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. Models present the prizes. (Game show) - 1972-09-04

buzzr.us.title: Card Sharks
buzzr.us.description: This show from legendary Mark Goodson-Bill Todman Productions features two contestants trying to predict answers to survey questions for the opportunity to play a game with oversized playing cards for a chance to win cash. One contestant guesses how many people (out of 100) gave a certain answer to a question and the other contestant then guesses if the number is higher or lower than the opponent's guess. The winning contestant then faces a row of cards and must determine if each succeeding card is higher or lower than the one that precedes it. The contestant who wins two out of three games wins the match and plays the bonus round, called Money Cards. The Money Cards round is similar to the card game in the main game but with three levels of cards instead of one row. The contestant is given $200 at the beginning of Money Cards and wagers any or all of that money when guessing if the cards will be higher or lower than the previous one. A perfect round could earn the contestant $28,800. (Game show) - 1978-04-24

cinevault.us.title: North
cinevault.us.description: North (Elijah Wood) is a talented and bright kid, but his mom (Julia Louis-Dreyfus) and dad (Jason Alexander) are utterly preoccupied with other things in their lives, leaving him largely ignored. Advised by a mysterious man (Bruce Willis) who pops up on occasion, North decides to legally separate himself from his parents and goes on a search across the globe for the ideal mother and father. Unfortunately for the young boy, most of the people that he meets have very little potential. (Children, Comedy drama, Movie) - 1994-07-22

cinevault.us.title: Lost & Found
cinevault.us.description: Sent to spend the summer with their uncle on a remote island, young brothers, Andy (Justin Kelly) and Mark (Benjamin Stockham), learn that their eccentric grandfather once owned the island but vanished without a trace, taking with him the secret to a vast fortune. Delving into the mysterious past of the island, the brothers discover that their grandfather designed a complex treasure hunt, a hunt that could lead to unimaginable wealth and heal their broken family. (Adventure, Drama, Movie, Mystery) - 2016-02-22

cinevault.us.title: Open Season
cinevault.us.description: Boog (Martin Lawrence), a 900-pound grizzly bear, is content entertaining tourists and living in park ranger Beth's (Debra Messing) barn. His life takes a drastic turn when he rescues a one-horned mule deer named Elliot (Ashton Kutcher) from a hunter (Gary Sinise), and is subsequently tranquilized and returned to the wild. Elliot and Boog recruit the other animals, notably a Scottish squirrel (Billy Connolly) and a beaver foreman, to help turn the tables on the hunters to make the woods safe. (Adventure, Animated, Children, Comedy, Movie) - 2006-09-29

cinevault.us.title: The Buddy Holly Story
cinevault.us.description: A chronicle of the rise and brief career of rock 'n' roll star Buddy Holly (Gary Busey), who aspires to play music the way he wants it to sound. Holly and his band, the Crickets, are first invited to record in Nashville, where they encounter creative differences with the producing staff. Later they play a major booking at the Apollo Theater, scheduled there under the mistaken assumption that they're a black band. Holly's career eventually goes solo -- until the tragic day the music dies. (Biography, Movie, Music, Rock) - 1978-05-18

cinevault.us.title: The Mask of Zorro
cinevault.us.description: After being imprisoned for 20 years, Zorro -- Don Diego de la Vega (Anthony Hopkins) -- receives word that his old enemy, Don Rafael Montero (Stuart Wilson), has returned. Don Diego escapes and returns to his old headquarters, where he trains aimless drunk Alejandro Murrieta (Antonio Banderas) to be his successor. Meanwhile, Montero -- who has secretly raised Diego's daughter, Elena (Catherine Zeta-Jones), as his own -- hatches a plot to rob California of its gold. (Action, Adventure, Comedy, Drama, Movie) - 1998-07-17

cinevault.us.title: The Legend of Zorro
cinevault.us.description: A secret society, the Knights of Aragon, seeks to keep the United States from achieving manifest destiny -- and only the legendary Zorro (Antonio Banderas) can stop them. Unfortunately, Zorro, also known as Don Alejandro de la Vega, has problems of his own: His wife, Elena (Catherine Zeta-Jones), is divorcing him for spending too much time pursuing heroics and not enough being a father to their young son. But it isn't long before the whole family gets caught up in stopping the Knights. (Action, Adventure, Movie) - 2005-10-28

cinevault.us.title: Brian's Song
cinevault.us.description: Although they both play for the Chicago Bears, Brian Piccolo (Sean Maher) is white, a joker and mostly rides the bench while Gale Sayers (Mekhi Phifer) is black, serious and a rookie superstar. Neither likes the other much, but when coach Halas (Ben Gazzara) makes them the first interracial roommates in the NFL, the two gradually form a sincere friendship. Piccolo helps Sayers overcome an injury, and Sayers later gives Piccolo much needed support when he's diagnosed with terminal cancer. (Docudrama, Movie) - 2001-12-02

cinevault.us.title: Crossroads

cinevault.us.title: The Baby-Sitters Club
cinevault.us.description: Kristy Thomas and her six best friends struggle to make their successful business -- the Baby-Sitters Club -- into a full-fledged summer day camp. When a group of adults led by their crotchety neighbor, Emily Haberman, tries to shut down the camp, the girls must band together to keep their dream alive. Meanwhile, each club member faces her own personal challenges, including divorced parents, a discouraging diabetes diagnosis and an innocent crush on an older boy. (Children, Drama, Movie) - 1995-08-18

cinevault.us.title: Annie

When a rich man named Oliver "Daddy" Warbucks decides to let an orphan live at his home to promote his image, Annie is selected. While Annie gets accustomed to living in Warbucks' mansion, she still longs to meet her parents. So Warbucks announces a search for them and a reward, which brings out many frauds. (Children, Movie, Musical comedy) - 1982-05-20

cinevault.us.title: The Green Hornet

After his father (Tom Wilkinson) dies, Britt meets Kato (Jay Chou), a resourceful company employee. Realizing that they have the talent and resources to make something of their lives, Britt and Kato join forces as costumed crime-fighters to bring down the city's most-powerful criminal, Chudnofsky (Christoph Waltz). (Action, Adventure, Movie) - 2011-01-14

cinevault.us.title: Blue Streak

After serving two years, Miles returns to the location of his treasure and finds it is now a police station. Disguising himself as a recently transferred officer to infiltrate the building, Miles stops an escaping thief while trying to retrieve the jewel. Impressed by his quick action, superior Rizzo partners him with the bumbling detective Casey. (Action, Comedy, Movie) - 1999-09-17

When Norman finally returns, the siblings resume their fishing outings, and assess both where they've been and where they're going. (Drama, Movie) - 1992-09-13

Despite early arguments with his manager, Pop Fisher (Wilford Brimley), Hobbs becomes one of the best players in the league, and the Knights start winning. But this upsets the Judge (Robert Prosky), their owner, who wants Hobbs to lose games, not win. (Drama, Movie) - 1984-05-11

(Action, Thriller, Crime drama, Mystery) - 2015

There, she meets a young girl named Rivkah (Brittany Murphy), a fellow captive in the camp. As Rivkah and Hannah struggle to survive in the face of daily atrocities, they form an unbreakable bond. (Drama, Fantasy, War) - 1999

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Blind Horizon

Despite the man's unstable state, Sheriff Jack Kolb (Sam Shepard) is troubled by Frank's story. Discovering the truth grows more complicated when Chloe Richards (Neve Campbell) arrives and claims to be Frank's fiancée, even though he has no memory of her. (movie) - 2004

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Prom Night

Now high-school students, the guilt-ridden kids have kept their involvement a secret, but when they start being murdered, one by one, it's clear that someone knows the truth. Also coping with the past are members of the dead girl's family, most notably her prom-queen sister, Kim Hammond. (movie) - 1980

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: The Long Walk Home

Odessa is participating in the Montgomery bus boycott, protesting against the inequality between blacks and whites, so Miriam decides to offer Odessa a ride to work every day. Though the community and Miriam's husband insist she not get involved, the relationship between Miriam and Odessa has already changed for the better. (movie) - 1990

When the agency targets him for termination, his former handler activates his latent skills, turning the mild-mannered slacker into a deadly weapon. Now, the utterly surprised Mike must use his newfound abilities to save himself and his girlfriend from getting smoked. (Action, Comedy, Movie) - 2015-08-21

moviesphere.us.title: The Unbearable Weight of Massive Talent
moviesphere.us.description: Unfulfilled and facing financial ruin, actor Nick Cage accepts a $1 million offer to attend a wealthy fan's birthday party. Things take a wildly unexpected turn when a CIA operative recruits Cage for an unusual mission. Taking on the role of a lifetime, he soon finds himself channeling his most iconic and beloved characters to save himself and his loved ones. (Action, Comedy, Movie) - 2022-03-12

moviesphere.us.title: The Hitman's Bodyguard
moviesphere.us.description: The world's top protection agent is called upon to guard the life of his mortal enemy, one of the world's most notorious hit men. During their journey from England to the Hague, they encounter high-speed car chases, outlandish boat escapades and a merciless Eastern European dictator who is out for blood. (Action, Comedy, Crime, Movie, Thriller) - 2017-08-18

moviesphere.us.title: The Hitman's Wife's Bodyguard

moviesphere.us.title: Long Shot
moviesphere.us.description: Fred Flarsky is a gifted and free-spirited journalist who has a knack for getting into trouble. When Fred unexpectedly runs into Charlotte, he soon realizes that she was his former baby sitter and childhood crush. When Charlotte decides to make a run for the presidency, she impulsively hires Fred as her speechwriter -- much to the dismay of her trusted advisers. (Comedy, Movie, Romance, Romantic comedy) - 2019-03-09

moviesphere.us.title: A Simple Favor

outlaw.us.title: Montana
outlaw.us.description: Aussie shepherd Morgan Lane (Errol Flynn) moves all the way to Montana in hopes of finding the perfect terrain for raising his sheep, but the local ranchers aren't keen on sharing their land with outsiders. Before long, Morgan clashes with powerful cattleman Rodney Ackroyd, and their rivalry is only intensified when Ackroyd's fiancée, Maria (Alexis Smith), has eyes for Morgan. However, her sympathies still lie with her lover, and it seems that only a gunfight can settle the conflict. (Western) - 1950

outlaw.us.title: The Old Way
outlaw.us.description: Retired gunslinger Colton Briggs faces the consequences of his past when the son of a man he murdered arrives to take his revenge. Briggs must take up arms once more after his wife is killed, and is joined by his young daughter. (Western, Action) - 2023

outlaw.us.title: The First Texan
outlaw.us.description: Having left his post as governor of Tennessee, Gen. Sam Houston (Joel McCrea) resettles in Mexican territory along the southwest U.S. border. He soon sets his sights on reclaiming the land under the aegis of Texas independence, while romancing post-divorce new love interest Katherine Delaney (Felicia Farr). His efforts eventually lead to the historic Battle of San Jacinto and a very clever bit of battlefield strategy by Houston in his fight against forces led by Gen. Santa Anna. (Western) - 1956

outlaw.us.title: The Oklahoman
outlaw.us.description: While moving his family out West, Dr. John Brighton (Joel McCrea) loses his wife in childbirth. After her death, John sets up his home in Indian territory. By the time his daughter is 7 years old, two women are competing for the doctor's affections: Ann (Barbara Hale), a rancher's widow, and Maria (Gloria Talbott), a young Native American maiden who watches over the doctor's daughter. When the town bully, Mel (Douglas Dick), wants to take the land of Maria's father, the doctor gets involved. (Western) - 1957

outlaw.us.title: Death Rides a Horse
outlaw.us.description: Having witnessed the brutal murder of his entire family by bandits at the age of 5, Bill Meceita has spent 15 years planning his vengeance. Finding a kindred spirit in Ryan, an experienced gunslinger seeking his own revenge on those who framed him, the two team up to find and kill Walcott, a fearsome bandit on the loose. But Bill soon discovers that Ryan may know more about his tragic past than he has let on. (Western) - 1969

outlaw.us.title: Adios Amigo

outlaw.us.title: Along the Great Divide
outlaw.us.description: A U.S. marshal (Kirk Douglas) leads a lynch-mob survivor, his daughter (Virginia Mayo) and others across the desert to justice. (Western) - 1951

outlaw.us.title: Stars in My Crown
outlaw.us.description: Man of God Josiah Gray (Joel McCrea) is determined to bring religion to the people of Walesburg, a dusty southern town still healing from the Civil War. Though initially Josiah must hold his parishioners at gunpoint, in time he wins over the community and marries his organist, Harriet (Ellen Drew). As the years pass, a number of situations arise, including a typhoid outbreak and a hostile mob, in which Josiah must prove that God is the only force that can restore peace in Walesburg. (Drama) - 1950

outtvproud.us.title: Cruel Intentions

However, Sebastian gets more than he bargained for as he attempts to woo Annette into his bed. (Drama) - 1999

outtvproud.us.title: Frankenstein
outtvproud.us.description: In this re-imagining of Mary Shelley's classic, Dr. Frankenstein is Dr. Victor Helios (Thomas Kretschmann), who has found the means to prolong his life into the present. Portrayed as the villain, Helios has amassed a collection of monsters that are killing people in New Orleans. Detectives Carson O'Connor (Parker Posey) and Michael Sloane (Adam Goldberg) team with the doctor's first creation, Deucalion (Vincent Perez), to track down and stop the crazed evil scientist. (Horror, Mystery, Thriller) - 2004

outtvproud.us.title: Cyborg 2: Glass Shadow
outtvproud.us.description: A cyborg designed to appear convincingly human, Casella "Cash" Reese (Angelina Jolie) is a spy and assassin for the massive Pinwheel Corporation. Set to ultimately self-destruct, Cash attempts to evade her fate with the aid of martial-arts expert and trainer Colson "Colt" Ricks (Elias Koteas) and a rebellious fellow cyborg named Mercy (Jack Palance). Naturally, the company doesn't want to lose one of their prize assets, so the ruthless Daniel Bench (Billy Drago) is sent to track Cash down. (movie) - 1993

outtvproud.us.title: Repo! The Genetic Opera

Those who miss their payments become targets of GeneCo. Mercenaries, who repossess the organs. In a world of drug addiction and legalized murder, a sheltered youth seeks a cure for her rare disease as well as information about her family's mysterious history. paranormalfiles.us.title: Unsealed: Alien Files
paranormalfiles.us.description: In April 2011 the FBI declassified decades' worth of secret government documents that contain thousands of reports of UFO sightings and alien activity. Each episode of this half-hour series tackles one alien case by investigating the previously off-limits government files. The program re-examines key evidence and follows developing leads based on newly released information. Mass UFO sightings, personal abductions, government cover-ups, and alien news from around the world are some of the topics covered by the show's panel of specialists, who include journalists, researchers, and radio and TV hosts. After watching an episode of "Unsealed: Alien Files," you may begin to believe that "we are not alone." (Documentary, Paranormal) - 2012-09-17

truehistory.us.title: The World's Greatest Churches - Hagia Sophia
truehistory.us.description: Learning about the past of this jewel of Constantinople; discovering an extraordinary architectural space; highlighting its dome and interiors; lingering over its mosaics, carved columns and decoration in colored marbles. (Religious) - 2014-10-24

truehistory.us.title: The World's Greatest Churches - The Cave Churches of Cappadocia
truehistory.us.description: Pondering the unusual churches of Turkish Cappadocia, elaborately carved into the sides of mountains; the lives of the monks and hermits who live there; studying the churches' frescoes that illustrate biblical scenes and the life of Jesus. (Religious) - 2014-10-24

truehistory.us.title: The World's Greatest Churches - Great Churches of Russia
truehistory.us.description: The beauties of the churches of the Russian Orthodox tradition; the religious culture that inspires these structures; their characteristic gilded domes; their decoration of sculpture, frescoes and tile work; visiting outstanding cathedrals. (Religious) - 2014-10-24

truehistory.us.title: Turning Points in Middle Eastern History - Muslim Empires: Land, Language, Religion
truehistory.us.description: The geographical region known as Greater Middle East; the range of nations and cultures that define it; historical turning points to witness, encompassing conquests, political alliances and Islam's rise; social, intellectual and economic reforms. (World history) - 2016-02-05

truehistory.us.title: Turning Points in Middle Eastern History - Muhammad and the Dawn of Islam - 622
truehistory.us.description: Islam's rise is a major turning point; tracing key phases in the life of Muhammad (PBUH); the founding of the faith through his years of opposition; his establishment of Islam as a religious and political entity; the global impact of these events. (World history) - 2016-02-05

truehistory.us.title: The History and Achievements of the Islamic Golden Age - From Camels to Stars in the Middle East
truehistory.us.description: One of the most important yet overlooked periods in human history; the who, what, why, where, when and how of the Golden Age of Islamic Civilization; exploring the Abbasid Empire; how it bridged the ancient world and the Renaissance. (World history) - 2017-02-03

truehistory.us.title: The History and Achievements of the Islamic Golden Age - Ibn Battuta's Search for Knowledge
truehistory.us.description: Meeting the Moroccan wayfarer Ibn Battuta; tracing his journey across Northern Africa and the Middle East in the century after the Mongol sack of Baghdad; new insights into the era, including whether it ever truly come to an end. (World history) - 2017-02-03

truehistory.us.title: Great Board Games of the Ancient World - Bearing Off: The Story of Backgammon
truehistory.us.description: During the Third Crusade, the European soldiers spend the winter playing the ancient game of Tables, which would evolve into backgammon by the 20th century. (History) - 2022-07-15

truehistory.us.title: Great Board Games of the Ancient World - Senet: Egypt's Game of the Afterlife
truehistory.us.description: Unearthed artifacts from King Tutankhamun's tomb include Senet boards. Historians study the hieroglyphs and investigate the abrupt disappearance of this ancient Egyptian game. (History) - 2022-07-15

truehistory.us.title: The United States and the Middle East: 1914 to 9/11 - A Meeting of Two Worlds
truehistory.us.description: Introducing the themes of increasing American power; indigenous political aspirations; conflicting interests and goals; growing mutual antagonism; setting the stage for World War I. (Educational, History) - 2003-06-09

truehistory.us.title: The United States and the Middle East: 1914 to 9/11 - Wilson & the Breakup of the Ottoman Empire
truehistory.us.description: An examination of wartime and postwar American policy; showing how Wilson's commitment to an ethnocentrically defined view of national self-determination drives his efforts to shape the postwar settlement in the Middle East. (Educational, History) - 2003-06-09

truehistory.us.title: Ancient Mesopotamia: Life in the Cradle of Civilization - Uncovering Near Eastern Civilization
truehistory.us.description: Egypt, Greece and Rome may be better known to the public; more written evidence survives from Mesopotamia; embarking on a journey through over 3,000 years of history; learning why Mesopotamia's rediscovery is so valuable. (World history) - 2018-04-27

truehistory.us.title: Ancient Mesopotamia: Life in the Cradle of Civilization - Natufian Villagers and Early Settlements
truehistory.us.description: The enormous value of plant and animal domestication; the theories about the transition from a hunter-gatherer lifestyle to agriculture; the challenges that farming presents; a perspective on the cultural sophistication of pre-agrarian peoples. (World history) - 2018-04-27

truehistory.us.title: The Holy Land Revealed - The Land of Canaan
truehistory.us.description: What is meant by "holy land"; the difference between archeology and history; how reliable the Hebrew Bible is as a window into life in ancient Israel; answers to these and other questions; the region's earliest recorded inhabitants, the Canaanites. (Religious) - 2010-11-12

truehistory.us.title: The Holy Land Revealed - The Arrival of the Israelites
truehistory.us.description: What archeologists uncover about the arrival of the Israelites into Canaan; an ancient Egyptian stele with the earliest reference to Israel; the remains of Jericho's walls; a Philistine temple similar to the one Samson destroys in the book of Judges. (Religious) - 2010-11-12

truehistory.us.title: The History of the Bible: The Making of the New Testament Canon - The New Testament-An Overview
truehistory.us.description: The course begins by addressing some of the basic facts about the New Testament; which books it contains, when they are written, in what language and by whom. (Educational) - 2005-10-03

truehistory.us.title: The History of the Bible: The Making of the New Testament Canon - Paul-Our Earliest Christian Author
truehistory.us.description: The Epistles of Paul are the earliest books of the New Testament, predating even the Gospels; the realities of writing a letter in the ancient world; issues that affect how one understands Paul's Epistles and the other writings of the New Testament. (Educational) - 2005-10-03

truehistory.us.title: The World of Biblical Israel - Biblical Israel - The Story of a People
truehistory.us.description: Entering the world of biblical Israel with a historical overview; an examination of how the Bible gives insights into the daily life of ancient Israelites; considering the context for how the Bible comes into being. (Educational) - 2013-10-25

truehistory.us.title: The World of Biblical Israel - By the Rivers of Babylon - Exile
truehistory.us.description: A look at the Babylonian exile; the exiled Judeans begin asking themselves who they are as a people and why they are conquered; as the Bible begins to be compiled in this time of exile, it offers two vantage points for understanding its history. (Educational) - 2013-10-25

10shakeperth.au.title: Mr. Crocodile
10shakeperth.au.description: S1 E10 Finders Keepers / Dancing Croc Mr. Crocodile takes the motto finders, keepers a bit too far. // Daisy and Mr. Crocodile arrange a dance performance for Mrs. Flores after they find her old dance shoes.

10shakeperth.au.title: Garden Academy
10shakeperth.au.description: S1 E28 The Number 8 It looks like Margarita is afraid of insects. But there's also Super Monte to help her, or not? Gardener Tim teaches them to overcome their fear. They also learn how to count to number 8.

10shakeperth.au.title: Blaze and the Monster Machines
10shakeperth.au.description: S6 E22 Lifeguard Blaze! Today, Blaze and AJ are on a mission to become Lifeguards. But it'll take four daring rescues to achieve their official Lifeguard badge and only the bravest monster trucks have what it takes.

10shakeperth.au.title: Blaze and the Monster Machines
10shakeperth.au.description: S6 E22 Campfire Stories It's a campout under the stars! Blaze, AJ, Starla, Crusher, and Pickle are gathered around the campfire to tell the most amazing stories they can make up!

10shakeperth.au.title: Paw Patrol
10shakeperth.au.description: S7 E3 Pups Save An Antarctic Martian/pups Save The Maze Explorers Travelling Travis is on another great adventure when he lands in Antarctica but believes he's actually on Mars./ Mr. Porter and Alex go on a sightseeing hike but get trapped inside a huge maze! The Paw Patrol has to find their friends!

10shakeperth.au.title: Paw Patrol
10shakeperth.au.description: S7 E4 Mighty Pups Charged Up: Pups Vs. Three Super Baddies Harold, Ladybird, and the Copycat team up and the three super baddies take the Mighty Pups' mighty meteor! The Mighty Pups have to get their meteor back and Charge Up to stop them before the team of baddies destroys Adventure Bay!

10shakeperth.au.title: Dora
10shakeperth.au.description: S3 E12 Halloween's Been Swiped / The Pumpkin Party Mystery Dora and Boots find out who's been swiping everyone's candy and save Halloween! / Dora and Boots solve the mystery of the missing pumpkin just in time for everyone to celebrate the Pumpkin Party!

10shakeperth.au.title: Dora
10shakeperth.au.description: S3 E7 Learning To Fly / Queen Swiper Dora and Boots help Dulce the Dragon learn to fly to reunite with her parents at Cloudy Caves. / They help La Reina and Swiper switch back after Big Red Chicken's magic mix-up!

10shakeperth.au.title: Baby Shark's Big Show
10shakeperth.au.description: S1 E9 When You Wish Upon A Fish / Shark-Off Baby and friends set out to climb Wish Mountain and make a wish on the legendary shooting starfish, Ol' Sea Breeze. / Shadow challenges Baby Shark to a Shark-Off to prove who's the sharkiest shark.

10shakeperth.au.title: Baby Shark's Big Show
10shakeperth.au.description: S1 E7 The Show Must Flow On / Detective Baby Shark When Goldie's feeling down, Baby and friends decide to put on a musical to help her shine. / When Grandma's shortcake goes missing before the bake-off, it's a case for Detective Baby Shark.

10shakeperth.au.title: Ni Hao Kai Lan
10shakeperth.au.description: S2 E9 Rintoo Makes a Splash Ye Ye takes Kai-lan and her friends to a special water park! Everyone is having fun until Rintoo starts playing too rough.

10shakeperth.au.title: Ni Hao Kai Lan
10shakeperth.au.description: S2 E10 The Ants Dance Kai-lan wants to help the ants put on a big dance show for everyone.

10shakeperth.au.title: Paw Patrol
10shakeperth.au.description: S11 E2 Rescue Wheels: Pups Save The Risky Race / Rescue Wheels: Pups Save The Runaway Truck When Boomer challenges Roxi in a race to the top of a mountain, his driving causes a avalanche of boulders! // When Boomer's monster truck stunt goes wrong, his truck is left without a driver.

10shakeperth.au.title: Paw Patrol
10shakeperth.au.description: S11 E3 Pups Plus A Plucky Chicken / Pups Save A Pet Show Humdinger steals Farmer Al's super-powered seeds. // Today is Adventure Bay's Twin It To win It pet show, where owners and their pets dress in matching outfits.

10shakeperth.au.title: Unicorn Academy
10shakeperth.au.description: S2 E4 Wildstar's Dream Using a sleepover at the stables as their cover, the Sapphires sneak out in search of the crown stars. But they're not the only ones looking.

10shakeperth.au.title: Gabby's Dollhouse
10shakeperth.au.description: S3 E17 Charm Bracelet Treasure Hunt Gabby unboxes a charm bracelet that has a tiny bottle charm with a treasure map inside! Following the clues on the map, we travel through the dollhouse, solving riddles.

10shakeperth.au.title: Rubble & Crew
10shakeperth.au.description: S4 E13 The Crew Builds A Sporting Goods Store / The Crew Plays Construction Vehicle Soccer Rubble & Crew help Coach Karima and Shopkeeper Shelley team up to open Builder Cove's first ever sporting goods store. // The pups move a giant watermelon for Farmer Zoe.

10shakeperth.au.title: Rubble & Crew
10shakeperth.au.description: S1 E1 The Crew Builds A Bridge Rubble and his construction pup family gear up to build a bridge, only to find the villainous Speed Meister has a different idea. It's up to Rubble & Crew to work together and save the day.

10shakeperth.au.title: Garden Academy
10shakeperth.au.description: S1 E24 The Color Green Gardener Tim invites Col and Monte to a class about the wonderful colour green. They have fun together reviewing all the things they know that are green: the leaves, frogs, or broccoli, for example.

10shakeperth.au.title: Paw Patrol
10shakeperth.au.description: S6 E21 Mighty Pups, Charged Up: Mighty Pups Versus The Copycat The Mighty Pups get charged up to take on new super-baddie, The Copycat. It'll take all new powers and gear to take down their most formidable foe to date.

10shakeperth.au.title: Paw Patrol
10shakeperth.au.description: S6 E22 Pups Save A Humsquatch / Pups Save A Flying Disc Fling Travelling Travis yelps for help when he finds a mysterious creature in trouble. The PAW Patrol heads to Foggy Bottom to save a Humsquatch!

10shakeperth.au.title: Henry Danger
10shakeperth.au.description: S5 E27 Envygram Wall Captain Man and Kid Danger are guarding Swellview's newest attraction, the EnvyGram Wall, when Captain Man destroys the wall, Kid Danger and Captain Man have to figure out a way to replace it.

10shakeperth.au.title: The Creature Cases
10shakeperth.au.description: S1 E11 The Puzzle Of The Poisonous Leaves / The Mystery Of The Missing Hare Something's funky in the food at a jungle resort for howler monkeys // Snowshoe hares need to find a missing camper during their trip to the forest.

10shakeperth.au.title: Pig Goat Banana Cricket
10shakeperth.au.description: S1 E19 Cow Duck Avocado Mantis Pig wants to be a famous belt in an action movie. Goat is discovered by a movie director. Banana must replace his hero on a hit television show. Cricket thinks he can make a movie all by himself.

10shakeperth.au.title: Kamp Koral: SpongeBob's Under Years
10shakeperth.au.description: S1 E17 Camp Crossbones/a Jelly Life After SpongeBob, Patrick, and Sandy are banned from playing pirates outside, they decide to turn their cabin into a pirate ship. // SpongeBob pretends to be a jellyfish for research purposes.

10shakeperth.au.title: The Patrick Star Show
10shakeperth.au.description: S4 E8 Pat-Tathlon / Upturn's Downturn The Patricks compete in a series of games for control of the TV remote. After driving over Patrick, a court order forces Lady Upturn to live with the Star family.

10shakeperth.au.title: Tyler Perry's Young Dylan
10shakeperth.au.description: S2 E19 Rap Dreams Do Come True Dylan discovers his new substitute teacher is a former rap star, but after successfully reviving the former star's profile, Dylan finds that his own dream remains out of reach.

10shakeperth.au.title: Tyler Perry's Young Dylan
10shakeperth.au.description: S2 E20 Waiting For Santa The family tries to make Dylan's first Christmas away from home special, but goes overboard trying to re-create his favourite traditions. Meanwhile, the kids don't have gifts for their parents.

10shakeperth.au.title: Rock, Paper, Scissors
10shakeperth.au.description: S1 E19 Diapers / R.O.V.E.R Scissors blindly sells his likeness to a new company... which sells diapers for babies with huge poops. // Rock tries to convince Paper and Scissors he's ready for a pet.

10shakeperth.au.title: Max & the Midknights
10shakeperth.au.description: S1 E2 Meet The Midknights When Uncle Budrick is held captive as King Gastley's jester, it's up to Max to rescue him from the castle's dungeon, with help from her newest pals, Simon, Millie, Kevyn, and wizard, Mumblin.

10shakeperth.au.title: Garden Academy
10shakeperth.au.description: S1 E26 My Pets! Col brings his pet (a cute little fish) to the class. And Gardener Tim uses the occasion to teach his students different types of pets. Rose learns about plurals and helps Col to name his fish.

10shakeperth.au.title: The Loud House
10shakeperth.au.description: S10 E12 Student Of The Jeer / Bean Dreams Stella tries to prove that she's not the teachers' pet. // Lori explores a potential career path after her boss suggests she has a strong future within the Burnt Bean organization.

10shakeperth.au.title: Nickelodeon Kids' Choice Awards 2026
10shakeperth.au.description: The annual awards ceremony celebrates fan-voted favorites across 36 categories in film, television, music, gaming, and sports, with winners receiving the signature orange blimp trophy.

10shakeperth.au.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
10shakeperth.au.description: S1 E6 Mermaid Man And Barnacle Boy/pickles Watching reruns of Mermaid Man & Barnacle Boy. // SpongeBob loses his self-confidence when an arrogant customer claims SpongeBob forgot to put pickles on his Krabby Patty.

10shakeperth.au.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
10shakeperth.au.description: S1 E7 Hall Monitor/jellyfish Jam Mrs. Puff's Boating School picks SpongeBob as this week's Hall Monitor. // Over the repeated warning of his friends, SpongeBob takes a wild jellyfish home.

10shakeperth.au.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
10shakeperth.au.description: S1 E8 Sandy's Rocket/squeaky Boots Sandy has taken on the enviable mission of taking a rocket ship into outer space. // Mr. Krabs surreptitiously gives SpongeBob a pair of squeaky boots in lieu of pay.

10shakeperth.au.title: The Graham Norton Show
10shakeperth.au.description: S33 E7 Episode 7 Glen Powell, Michelle Yeoh, Rosamund Pike and Jack Whitehall join Graham on his sofa. Ed Sheeran also joins the conversation after performing Camera from his album Play.

10shakeperth.au.title: The Graham Norton Show
10shakeperth.au.description: S34 E4 Quentin Tarantino, Ellen Degeneres, Colin Farrell, Gemma Chan Together on Graham's sofa: Quentin Tarantino, Ellen DeGeneres, Colin Farrell and Gemma Chan. With music from Suede, performing 'Dancing with the Europeans' from their current album 'Antidepressants'.

10shakeperth.au.title: Big Brother
10shakeperth.au.description: S17 E18 Episode 18 Anita is surprised by a visit from her dog Snowy, before the Weekly Feed rocks the house, leading to a confrontation between Marshy and the group over dinner. Another Live Eviction looms on the horizon.

10shakeperth.au.title: Big Brother
10shakeperth.au.description: S17 E19 Episode 19 Mel Tracina hosts live nominations. Matthew's eviction puts Marshie under fire. Tahlia confronts Kyrah and fends off Marshie's unwanted advice. Ebony and Austin look for a new buddy. Evie opens up.

abcentertains.au.title: Miraculous: Tales Of Ladybug And Cat Noir
abcentertains.au.description: Kuro Neko If Cat Noir decided to quit and give his Miraculous back to Ladybug, who could possibly replace him? (Animation, Series)

sbsbrisbane.au.title: Dinosaur With Stephen Fry - Dawn Of The Dinosaurs
sbsbrisbane.au.description: Stephen Fry is transported 155 million years back in time to the first Golden Age of the dinosaurs, the Jurassic, when they grew into giants. He explores the conifer forests and fern prairies that were their home, to encounter a monstrous plant-eating Diplodocus, and a deadly predator, the Allosaurus. Expert Dr Susie Maidment, from London's Natural History Museum, arrives to help decode these dinosaurs' remarkable behaviour. (Documentary)

sbsbrisbane.au.title: Icons Of Auto - Maserati
sbsbrisbane.au.description: It is a story of undeniable passion, strong family bonds and legends of speed. For over a century Maserati helps redefine the Italian automotive scene thanks to its bold engineering, revolutionary designs, and audacious machines. (Documentary)

sbsbrisbane.au.description: The latest national and international news stories from the BBC News team from London, UK, in English. (News)

sbsbrisbane.au.description: International news and current affairs television from Paris, offering a French perspective on world events, in English. (News, Current Affairs)

sbsbrisbane.au.description: Reviews and analysis of the day's news, presented by Amna Nawaz and Geoff Bennett for the Public Broadcasting Service (PBS) in the United States.

sbsbrisbane.au.title: Mtb Enduro National Championships 2026 - Auscycling Mtb Enduro National Championships 2026 Highlights
sbsbrisbane.au.description: All the best moments from the 2026 AusCycling MTB Enduro National Championships, as Australia's best Enduro riders head to Collie, Western Australia to compete for national glory. (Sports)

sbsbrisbane.au.title: Plat Du Tour - Poulet De Bresse With Morels
sbsbrisbane.au.description: Guillaume spends time with chef George Blanc, whose family won the first of three Michelin stars way back in 1929. George shares the coveted secrets of his Poulet De Bresse with Guillaume. (Special Interest)

sbsbrisbane.au.title: Going Places With Ernie Dingo - Sunday Island, Atherton Tablelands, Hobart
sbsbrisbane.au.description: Ernie traverses the blue waters and tidal passages to Sunday Island, Aaron experiences the magic and culture of the Atherton Tablelands and Rae hears the history of Hobart from a Palawa perspective. (Entertainment)

sbsbrisbane.au.title: Cuban Missile Crisis
sbsbrisbane.au.description: With archival footage and access to unclassified CIA documents, The Cuban Missile Crisis takes you on a journey, from the beginnings of the Cold War right up to its peak in 1962, when the world nearly faced nuclear destruction. A compelling tale of geopolitical tension, diplomacy and the quest for power. (Documentary)

sbsbrisbane.au.title: SBS World News - Sbs World News 2026 Ep 325 ᴸᶦᵛᵉ
sbsbrisbane.au.description: Latest reports and analysis of major national and international news of the day from Australia's only world news service. (News)

sbsbrisbane.au.title: Royals And Their Gardens - Audley End House And Gardens
sbsbrisbane.au.description: Audley End House, a Jacobean mansion built to impress King James I, became the centre of scandal when its owner, Thomas Howard, was jailed for embezzlement. Later a royal retreat under Charles II and a WWII spy base, the estate has seen royal drama, financial ruin, and espionage. Today, with gardens by Capability Brown and interiors by Robert Adam, it stands as a grand relic of England's aristocratic legacy. (Documentary)

sbsbrisbane.au.title: The Three Kings Of 1936 - Three Kings Of 1936, The
sbsbrisbane.au.description: Narrated by Tracy-Ann Oberman, The Three Kings of 1936 explores a pivotal year in royal history. Through rare archive material, expert analysis and eyewitness accounts, it traces the death of George V, the abdication of Edward VIII and the accession of George VI. Set against a backdrop of social change and political turmoil, it reveals how these events reshaped the monarchy. (Documentary)

sbsbrisbane.au.title: The Story Of Irish Dance - Steps Of Freedom: The Story Of Irish Dance
sbsbrisbane.au.description: Steps of Freedom reveals the extraordinary story how Irish dance evolved over centuries from a simple folk dance to become a global phenomenon adored by millions around the world. Featuring stunning original performances by some of the greatest dance practitioners and a wealth of archive materials. (Documentary)

sbsbrisbane.au.title: The Good Ship Murder - At Sea
sbsbrisbane.au.description: The world's top poker players assemble for a tournament at sea as a murder forces Jack and Kate to put their cards on the table. (Drama)

sbsbrisbane.au.title: The Good Ship Murder - Sicily
sbsbrisbane.au.description: A Sicilian businessman's illness paves the way for a succession race among his spoiled children as Jack makes a new connection. (Drama)

sbsmelbourne.au.title: Royals And Their Gardens - Audley End House And Gardens

Later a royal retreat under Charles II and a WWII spy base, the estate has seen royal drama, financial ruin, and espionage. Today, with gardens by Capability Brown and interiors by Robert Adam, it stands as a grand relic of England's aristocratic legacy. (Documentary)

sbsmelbourne.au.title: The Three Kings Of 1936 - Three Kings Of 1936, The

Through rare archive material, expert analysis and eyewitness accounts, it traces the death of George V, the abdication of Edward VIII and the accession of George VI. Set against a backdrop of social change and political turmoil, it reveals how these events reshaped the monarchy. (Documentary)

sbsmelbourne.au.title: The Story Of Irish Dance - Steps Of Freedom: The Story Of Irish Dance
sbsmelbourne.au.description: Steps of Freedom reveals the extraordinary story how Irish dance evolved over centuries from a simple folk dance to become a global phenomenon adored by millions around the world.
